const formatMetric = (val: number | string | undefined | null, maxDecimals = 2): string => {
  const num = parseFloat(String(val ?? 0));
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return "â€”";
  if (Math.abs(num) >= 1e9) return num.toExponential(3);
  return num.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: maxDecimals });
};

const CbamTab: React.FC<CbamTabProps> = ({
  ACTIVITY_LABELS,
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE,
  cbamForm,
  currentPage,
  editingCbamId,
  facilities,
  filteredCbam,
  getAvailableActivities,
  getAvailableDivisions,
  handleDeleteCbamExport,
  handleSaveCbamExport,
  setCbamForm,
  setCurrentPage,
  setEditingCbamId,
}) => {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isCustomCn, setIsCustomCn] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleExportCbamExcel = async () => {
    try {
      setExporting(true);
      toast.info(t("Generating EU CBAM Excel Communication Template..."));
      const res = await api.get("/reports/cbam-export?format=excel", {
        responseType: "blob",
      });
      const blob = new Blob([res.data], {
        type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
      });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "EU_CBAM_Communication_Template_Consolidated.xlsx";
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast.success(t("EU CBAM Communication Template downloaded successfully."));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("CBAM export failed:", err);
      toast.error(t("Failed to export CBAM template."));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCnCodeChange = (newCode: string) => {
    if (newCode === "Custom") {
      setIsCustomCn(true);
      setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, cn_code: "" });
      return;
    }
    setIsCustomCn(false);

    const matched = CN_OPTIONS.find((c) => c.code === newCode);
    const extra: Record<string, any> = { cn_code: newCode };

    // Auto-update product name if blank or set to a standard preset
    const currentName = cbamForm.product_name || "";
    if (!currentName || STANDARD_PRODUCT_NAMES.has(currentName)) {
      if (matched?.name) {
        extra.product_name = matched.name;
      }
    }

    if (matched?.isComplex) {
      extra.is_complex_good = true;
      extra.precursor_name = cbamForm.precursor_name || matched.precName || "Anhydrous Ammonia";
      extra.precursor_cn_code = cbamForm.precursor_cn_code || matched.precCn || "2814 10 00";
      extra.precursor_ratio = cbamForm.precursor_ratio || matched.precRatio || "0.567";
      extra.precursor_see_dir = cbamForm.precursor_see_dir || "1.7850";
      extra.precursor_see_indir = cbamForm.precursor_see_indir || "0.1420";
    } else if (matched) {
      extra.is_complex_good = false;
    }

    setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, ...extra });
  };

  const handlePrecursorToggle = (checked: boolean) => {
    if (checked) {
      setCbamForm({
        ...cbamForm,
        is_complex_good: true,
        precursor_name: cbamForm.precursor_name || "Anhydrous Ammonia",
        precursor_cn_code: cbamForm.precursor_cn_code || "2814 10 00",
        precursor_ratio: cbamForm.precursor_ratio || "0.567",
        precursor_see_dir: cbamForm.precursor_see_dir || "1.7850",
        precursor_see_indir: cbamForm.precursor_see_indir || "0.1420",
      });
    } else {
      setCbamForm({
        ...cbamForm,
        is_complex_good: false,
      });
    }
  };

  const rows = filteredCbam.slice((currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE, currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE);

  // Precursor contribution
  const pRatio = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.precursor_ratio || 0));
  const pDir = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.precursor_see_dir || 0));
  const pIndir = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.precursor_see_indir || 0));
  const pContrib = cbamForm.is_complex_good ? pRatio * (pDir + pIndir) : 0;

  // Live Summary metrics
  const quantityVal = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.quantity_tonnes || 0));
  const dirSeeVal = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.specific_embedded_direct || 0));
  const indirSeeVal = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.specific_embedded_indirect || 0));
  const totalSeeVal = dirSeeVal + indirSeeVal + pContrib;
  const totalEmbeddedVal = quantityVal * totalSeeVal;
  const carbonTaxVal = parseFloat(String(cbamForm.carbon_price_paid_eur || 0));

  // Determine current CN code for selector (normalizing 6-digit legacy codes)
  const rawCn = cbamForm.cn_code || "";
  const currentCnCode = rawCn === "2709 00" ? "2709 00 00" : rawCn || "2804 10 00";
  const isKnownCn = CN_OPTIONS.some((o) => o.code === currentCnCode);

  return (
    <TabCard
      title={t("EU CBAM Export & Embedded Emission Tracking (Oil & Gas Scope)")}
      description={t(
        "Record product exports subject to EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism tailored to Oil & Gas operations, including Clean Hydrogen, Ammonia, Fertilizers, Refinery streams, Carbon Capture & Storage (CCS), and Origin Carbon Taxes.",
      )}
      actions={
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="secondary"
          onClick={handleExportCbamExcel}
          disabled={exporting}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
        >
          <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4 text-text-secondary" aria-hidden="true" />
          {exporting ? t("Exporting...") : t("Export Official CBAM Template")}
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <FormGrid className="form-grid-3" cols="md:grid-cols-3">
        <Field label={t("Activity")}>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.activity || ""}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const act = e.target.value;
              const divs = getAvailableDivisions(act);
              const autoDiv = divs.length === 1 ? divs[0] : "";
              const facs = facilities.filter(
                (f) => (!act || f.activity === act) && (!autoDiv || f.division === autoDiv),
              );
              const autoFac = facs.length === 1 ? facs[0].id.toString() : "";
              setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, activity: act, division: autoDiv, facility_id: autoFac });
            }}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            <option value="">{t("-- Select Activity --")}</option>
            {getAvailableActivities().map((a) => (
              <option key={a} value={a}>
                {ACTIVITY_LABELS[a] || a}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Division")}>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.division || ""}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const div = e.target.value;
              const facs = facilities.filter(
                (f) => (!cbamForm.activity || f.activity === cbamForm.activity) && (!div || f.division === div),
              );
              const autoFac = facs.length === 1 ? facs[0].id.toString() : "";
              setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, division: div, facility_id: autoFac });
            }}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
            disabled={!cbamForm.activity}
          >
            <option value="">{t("-- Select Division --")}</option>
            {getAvailableDivisions(cbamForm.activity).map((d) => (
              <option key={d} value={d}>
                {d}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Facility / Production Site")} required>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.facility_id || ""}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const fid = e.target.value;
              const fac = facilities.find((f) => String(f.id) === String(fid));
              setCbamForm({
                ...cbamForm,
                facility_id: fid,
                activity: fac?.activity || cbamForm.activity,
                division: fac?.division || cbamForm.division,
              });
            }}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            <option value="">{t("-- Select Facility --")}</option>
            {facilities
              .filter(
                (f) =>
                  (!cbamForm.activity || f.activity === cbamForm.activity) &&
                  (!cbamForm.division || f.division === cbamForm.division),
              )
              .map((f) => (
                <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                  {f.name} ({f.location || f.field || t("General")})
                </option>
              ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("EU CN Code (Oil & Gas Scope)")} required>
          <NativeSelect
            value={isCustomCn ? "Custom" : currentCnCode}
            onChange={(e) => handleCnCodeChange(e.target.value)}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            {CN_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
              <option key={opt.code} value={opt.code}>
                {t(opt.label)}
              </option>
            ))}
            {!isKnownCn && currentCnCode && currentCnCode !== "Custom" && (
              <option value={currentCnCode}>{currentCnCode} ({t("Custom / Other")})</option>
            )}
            <option value="Custom">{t("Custom / Other CN Code")}</option>
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        {isCustomCn && (
          <Field label={t("Enter Custom EU CN Code")} required>
            <Input
              type="text"
              value={cbamForm.cn_code || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, cn_code: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={t("e.g. 2710 19 99")}
            />
          </Field>
        )}

        <Field label={t("Commercial Product Name")} required>
          <Input
            type="text"
            value={cbamForm.product_name || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, product_name: e.target.value })}
            placeholder={t("e.g. Export Blend Crude Oil")}
          />
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Export Destination")}>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.export_destination || "EU"}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, export_destination: e.target.value })}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            <option value="EU">{t("European Union (EU-27)")}</option>
            <option value="UK">{t("United Kingdom (UK CBAM)")}</option>
            <option value="US">{t("United States")}</option>
            <option value="APAC">{t("Asia-Pacific")}</option>
            <option value="Non-EU">{t("Other Non-EU")}</option>
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Reporting Month")}>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.month || 1}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const m = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
              const q = `Q${Math.floor((m - 1) / 3) + 1}`;
              setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, month: m, quarter: q });
            }}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
              <option key={i + 1} value={i + 1}>
                {new Date(2000, i).toLocaleString("default", { month: "long" })}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Reporting Quarter (DG TAXUD)")}>
          <NativeSelect
            value={cbamForm.quarter || "Q1"}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const q = e.target.value;
              const qMonthMap: Record<string, number> = { Q1: 1, Q2: 4, Q3: 7, Q4: 10 };
              setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, quarter: q, month: qMonthMap[q] || 1 });
            }}
            className={cn(controlClass, "component-select")}
          >
            <option value="Q1">{t("Q1 (Jan 01 - Mar 31)")}</option>
            <option value="Q2">{t("Q2 (Apr 01 - Jun 30)")}</option>
            <option value="Q3">{t("Q3 (Jul 01 - Sep 30)")}</option>
            <option value="Q4">{t("Q4 (Oct 01 - Dec 31)")}</option>
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Reporting Year")}>
          <Input
            type="number"
            value={cbamForm.year || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, year: e.target.value })}
          />
        </Field>

        <Field label={t("Export Quantity (Metric Tonnes)")} required>
          <Input
            type="number"
            value={cbamForm.quantity_tonnes || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, quantity_tonnes: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="0.00"
          />
        </Field>

        <Field
          label={t("Direct Specific Embedded (SEE_dir) (tCOâ‚‚e / t)")}
          hint={t("Auto-calculated from site if 0")}
        >
          <Input
            type="number"
            step="0.0001"
            value={cbamForm.specific_embedded_direct || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, specific_embedded_direct: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="0.000"
          />
        </Field>

        <Field
          label={t("Indirect Specific Embedded (SEE_indir) (tCOâ‚‚e / t)")}
          hint={t("Auto-calculated from Scope 2 if 0")}
        >
          <Input
            type="number"
            step="0.0001"
            value={cbamForm.specific_embedded_indirect || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, specific_embedded_indirect: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="0.000"
          />
        </Field>
      </FormGrid>

      {/* Carbon Capture & Geological Storage (CCS) Section */}
      <div className="mt-6 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-xs transition-colors">
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <ShieldCheck className="size-5 text-success-fg" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">
              {t("Carbon Capture & Permanent Storage (CCS)")}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <Badge tone="success" className="text-xs">
            {t("Net Direct SEE = max(0, Gross Direct - Captured COâ‚‚) / Quantity")}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label={t("Captured & Geologically Sequestered COâ‚‚ (Metric Tonnes)")}>
            <Input
              type="number"
              step="0.01"
              value={cbamForm.captured_co2_tonnes || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, captured_co2_tonnes: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="0.00 (e.g. 1540.50)"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t("CCS Geological Storage Certificate ID")}>
            <Input
              type="text"
              value={cbamForm.ccs_certificate_id || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, ccs_certificate_id: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={t("e.g. DZ-CCS-2026-IN-SALAH-001")}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Origin Carbon Price / Flaring Tax Section */}
      <div className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-xs transition-colors">
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Coins className="size-5 text-warning-fg" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">
              {t("Carbon Price & Flaring Fiscality Paid in Country of Origin")}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <Badge tone="warning" className="text-xs">
            {t("Directly credited against EU CBAM certificate surrender")}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label={t("Carbon Price / Flaring Penalty Rate (â‚¬ / t product)")}>
            <Input
              type="number"
              step="0.01"
              value={cbamForm.carbon_price_paid_eur || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, carbon_price_paid_eur: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="0.00 (e.g. 12.50)"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t("National Legal Basis & Fiscal Receipt Reference")}>
            <Input
              type="text"
              value={cbamForm.carbon_price_legal_ref || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, carbon_price_legal_ref: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={t("e.g. Hydrocarbon Law 19-13 Art. 42 / Decree 21-330")}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Complex Downstream Goods Precursor Attribution Section */}
      <div className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-xs transition-colors">
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Layers className="size-5 text-info-fg" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">
              {t("Complex Downstream Goods & Upstream Precursors (Ammonia / Urea / UAN)")}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <label className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-text select-none">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={Boolean(cbamForm.is_complex_good)}
              onChange={(e) => handlePrecursorToggle(e.target.checked)}
              className="size-4 rounded border-border text-primary accent-brand-500 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <span>{t("Declare Upstream Precursor Attribution")}</span>
          </label>
        </div>

        {cbamForm.is_complex_good && (
          <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
              <Field label={t("Relevant Precursor Name")}>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  value={cbamForm.precursor_name || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, precursor_name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder={t("e.g. Anhydrous Ammonia")}
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("Precursor EU CN Code")}>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  value={cbamForm.precursor_cn_code || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, precursor_cn_code: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="2814 10 00"
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("Consumption Ratio (t precursor / t product)")}>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.001"
                  value={cbamForm.precursor_ratio || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, precursor_ratio: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="0.567"
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 items-start">
              <Field label={t("Precursor Direct SEE (tCOâ‚‚e / t precursor)")}>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.0001"
                  value={cbamForm.precursor_see_dir || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, precursor_see_dir: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="1.7850"
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("Precursor Indirect SEE (tCOâ‚‚e / t precursor)")}>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.0001"
                  value={cbamForm.precursor_see_indir || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, precursor_see_indir: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="0.1420"
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("Precursor SEE Contribution (tCOâ‚‚e / t)")}>
                <div className="flex h-10 items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-border bg-ink-50 px-3.5 shadow-xs">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary">{t("Total Precursor SEE:")}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-brand-700">
                    +{pContrib.toFixed(4)} tCOâ‚‚e / t
                  </span>
                </div>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary mt-1">
              {t("Stoichiometric precursor embedded emissions are automatically added to the product's total declaration.")}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5">
        <Field label={t("Notes & Accredited Verification References")}>
          <Input
            type="text"
            value={cbamForm.notes || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setCbamForm({ ...cbamForm, notes: e.target.value })}
            placeholder={t("Accredited Verifier / Certificate ID")}
          />
        </Field>
      </div>

      {/* Live Calculated Declaration Summary Strip */}
      <div className="mt-6 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-50 p-4 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6">
            <div>
              <span className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                {t("Export Quantity")}
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-text">
                {quantityVal > 0 ? quantityVal.toLocaleString() : "0.00"} t
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden h-8 w-px bg-border sm:block" />
            <div>
              <span className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                {t("Direct SEE")}
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-text">
                {dirSeeVal.toFixed(4)} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-text-secondary">tCOâ‚‚e/t</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden h-8 w-px bg-border sm:block" />
            <div>
              <span className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                {t("Total Specific SEE")}
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-text">
                {totalSeeVal.toFixed(4)} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-text-secondary">tCOâ‚‚e/t</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden h-8 w-px bg-border sm:block" />
            <div>
              <span className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                {t("Total Embedded Emissions")}
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-brand-700">
                {totalEmbeddedVal.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-text-secondary">tCOâ‚‚e</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          {carbonTaxVal > 0 && quantityVal > 0 && (
            <Badge tone="warning" className="text-xs font-medium">
              {t("Origin Tax Credit:")} â‚¬{(carbonTaxVal * quantityVal).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <FormActions className="mt-6">
        <Button
          className="action-btn !h-10 !px-4 !py-0 !text-base !font-semibold !rounded-md !transform-none"
          onClick={handleSaveCbamExport}
        >
          {editingCbamId ? t("Update CBAM Record") : t("Save CBAM Record")}
        </Button>
        {editingCbamId && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => {
              setEditingCbamId(null);
              setIsCustomCn(false);
              setCbamForm({
                id: null,
                activity: "",
                division: "",
                facility_id: "",
                year: new Date().getFullYear(),
                month: 1,
                quarter: "Q1",
                product_name: "Clean & Low-Carbon Hydrogen",
                cn_code: "2804 10 00",
                quantity_tonnes: "",
                export_destination: "EU",
                specific_embedded_direct: "",
                specific_embedded_indirect: "",
                captured_co2_tonnes: "",
                ccs_certificate_id: "",
                carbon_price_paid_eur: "",
                carbon_price_legal_ref: "",
                is_complex_good: false,
                precursor_name: "",
                precursor_cn_code: "",
                precursor_ratio: "",
                precursor_see_dir: "",
                precursor_see_indir: "",
                notes: "",
              });
            }}
          >
            {t("Cancel Edit")}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          onClick={handleExportCbamExcel}
          disabled={exporting}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
        >
          <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4 text-text-secondary" aria-hidden="true" />
          {exporting ? t("Exporting...") : t("Export Official CBAM Template")}
        </Button>
      </FormActions>

      <RecordTable
        title={

                {pName}
              </Td>
              <Td className="whitespace-nowrap">
                <code className="rounded bg-ink-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-text">
                  {cnCode}
                </code>
              </Td>
              <Td className="whitespace-nowrap text-text-secondary text-xs">
                {c.year} - {qtr} (M{c.month || "1"})
              </Td>
              <Td className="whitespace-nowrap">
                <Badge tone="brand" className="text-xs">
                  {dest}
                </Badge>
              </Td>
              <Td className="text-right font-semibold text-text whitespace-nowrap">
                {formatMetric(qTonnes)}
              </Td>
              <Td className="text-right whitespace-nowrap">

                    -{formatMetric(ccsCaptured)} t
                  </Badge>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-text-secondary">â€”</span>
                )}
              </Td>
              <Td className="text-right font-mono text-xs text-text-secondary whitespace-nowrap">
                {direct.toFixed(4)}
              </Td>

              </Td>

                {formatMetric(totalEmbedded, 1)}
              </Td>

                        cn_code: cnCode,
                        quantity_tonnes: qTonnes.toString(),

                        precursor_ratio: precRatio ? precRatio.toString() : "",
                        precursor_see_dir: precDir ? precDir.toString() : "",
                        precursor_see_indir: precIndir ? precIndir.toString() : "",
                        notes: c.notes || "",
                      });

                  >
                    {t("Edit")}

                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="danger"
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteCbamExport(c.id)}
                  >
                    {t("Delete")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </Td>
            </Tr>

      </RecordTable>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Upload, Users, Trash2, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge, Button, Field, Input, controlClass } from "../../ui";
import { NativeSelect } from "../../ui/NativeSelect";
import { BOUNDARY_OPTIONS } from "../../constants";
import PaginationControls from "./PaginationControls";
import { FormActions, FormGrid, RecordTable, TabCard, Td, Tr } from "./MdParts";
import Modal from "../../components/Modal";
import api from "../../api";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import { apiError } from "../../utils/apiError";
import { t } from "../../i18n";

const SEGMENTS = ["Upstream", "Midstream", "Downstream", "Heavy Industry", "Utilities", "Other"];

export interface FacilityRecord {
  id: string | number;
  name: string;
  activity?: string;
  division?: string;
  field?: string;
  location?: string;
  boundary_notes?: string;
  boundary_type?: string;
  boundary_detail?: string;
  equity_share_pct?: number | string;
  segment?: string;
  latitude?: number | string;
  longitude?: number | string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export interface FacilitiesTabProps {
  ACTIVITY_LABELS: Record<string, string>;
  HIERARCHY: Record<string, string[]>;
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE: number;
  currentPage: number;
  exportToCSV: (data: any[], filename: string) => void;
  facilities: FacilityRecord[];
  facilityForm: Record<string, any>;
  filteredFacilities: FacilityRecord[];
  handleAddFacility: () => void;
  handleDeleteFacility: (id: string | number) => void;
  handleFacilityChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => void;
  setCurrentPage: (page: number) => void;
  setFacilityForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any>>;
  setImportModal: (modal: { isOpen: boolean; type: string }) => void;
  user?: { role?: string; [key: string]: any } | null;
}

const FacilitiesTab: React.FC<FacilitiesTabProps> = ({
  ACTIVITY_LABELS,
  HIERARCHY,
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE,
  currentPage,
  exportToCSV,
  facilities,
  facilityForm,
  filteredFacilities,
  handleAddFacility,
  handleDeleteFacility,
  handleFacilityChange,
  setCurrentPage,
  setFacilityForm,
  setImportModal,
  user,
}) => {
  const canEdit = ["admin", "superuser"].includes(user?.role || "");
  const [selectedFacilityForEquity, setSelectedFacilityForEquity] = useState<FacilityRecord | null>(null);
  const [partners, setPartners] = useState<Array<{ id: number; name: string; code: string; country: string }>>([]);
  const [shares, setShares] = useState<Array<any>>([]);
  const [loadingShares, setLoadingShares] = useState(false);
  const [partnerForm, setPartnerForm] = useState({ partner_id: "", equity_share_pct: "", agreement_reference: "", effective_start_date: "2021-01-01" });
  const toast = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedFacilityForEquity) {
      loadEquityData(selectedFacilityForEquity.id);
    }
  }, [selectedFacilityForEquity]);

  const loadEquityData = async (facilityId: string | number) => {
    setLoadingShares(true);
    try {
      const [pRes, sRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get("/equity/partners"),
        api.get(`/equity/shares?facility_id=${facilityId}`),
      ]);
      setPartners(pRes.data || []);
      setShares(sRes.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    } finally {
      setLoadingShares(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveShare = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedFacilityForEquity || !partnerForm.partner_id || !partnerForm.equity_share_pct) {
      toast.show(t("Partner and equity share percentage are required"), "warning");
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post("/equity/shares", {
        facility_id: Number(selectedFacilityForEquity.id),
        partner_id: Number(partnerForm.partner_id),
        equity_share_pct: parseFloat(partnerForm.equity_share_pct),
        effective_start_date: partnerForm.effective_start_date || "2021-01-01",
        agreement_reference: partnerForm.agreement_reference || undefined,
      });
      toast.show(t("Equity share updated successfully"), "success");
      setPartnerForm({ partner_id: "", equity_share_pct: "", agreement_reference: "", effective_start_date: "2021-01-01" });
      loadEquityData(selectedFacilityForEquity.id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteShare = async (shareId: number) => {
    try {
      await api.delete(`/equity/shares/${shareId}`);
      toast.show(t("Equity share removed"), "success");
      if (selectedFacilityForEquity) loadEquityData(selectedFacilityForEquity.id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  const patch = (fields: Record<string, any>) => setFacilityForm({ ...facilityForm, ...fields });
  const select = (
    name: string,
    onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => void,
    options: React.ReactNode,
    placeholder: string,
    disabled?: boolean,
  ) => (
    <NativeSelect
      name={name}
      value={facilityForm[name] || ""}
      onChange={onChange}
      className={controlClass}
      disabled={disabled}
    >
      <option value="">{placeholder}</option>
      {options}
    </NativeSelect>
  );
  const rows = filteredFacilities.slice((currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE, currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE);

  return (
    <TabCard title={t("Active Regions")} description={t("Manage operational regions and their boundaries.")}>
      {canEdit && (
        <>
          <FormGrid>
            <Field label={t("Region Name")}>
              <Input
                type="text"
                name="name"
                value={facilityForm.name || ""}
                onChange={handleFacilityChange}
                placeholder={t("e.g. Hassi R'Mel")}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Activity")}>
              {select(
                "activity",
                (e) => patch({ activity: e.target.value, division: "" }),
                Object.keys(HIERARCHY).map((a) => (
                  <option key={a} value={a}>
                    {ACTIVITY_LABELS[a]}
                  </option>
                )),
                t("Select Activity"),
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Division")}>
              {select(
                "division",
                handleFacilityChange,
                facilityForm.activity &&
                  HIERARCHY[facilityForm.activity]?.map((d) => (
                    <option key={d} value={d}>
                      {d}
                    </option>
                  )),
                t("Select Division"),
                !facilityForm.activity,
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Field / Block")}>
              <Input
                type="text"
                name="field"
                value={facilityForm.field || ""}
                onChange={handleFacilityChange}
                placeholder={t("Optional")}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Location (Wilaya)")}>
              <Input
                type="text"
                name="location"
                value={facilityForm.location || ""}
                onChange={handleFacilityChange}
                placeholder={t("e.g. Laghouat")}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Consolidation Approach")}>
              {select(
                "boundary_type",
                (e) => patch({ boundary_type: e.target.value, boundary_detail: "" }),
                Object.keys(BOUNDARY_OPTIONS).map((opt) => (
                  <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                    {opt}
                  </option>
                )),
                t("Select Approach"),
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Boundary Details")}>
              {select(
                "boundary_detail",
                (e) => patch({ boundary_detail: e.target.value }),
                facilityForm.boundary_type &&
                  BOUNDARY_OPTIONS[facilityForm.boundary_type]?.map((detail) => (
                    <option key={detail} value={detail}>
                      {detail}
                    </option>
                  )),
                t("Select Details"),
                !facilityForm.boundary_type,
              )}
            </Field>
            {facilityForm.boundary_type === "Equity Share" && (
              <Field label={t("Equity Share Percentage (%)")}>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0"
                  max="100"
                  name="equity_share_pct"
                  value={facilityForm.equity_share_pct !== undefined ? facilityForm.equity_share_pct : ""}
                  onChange={(e) => patch({ equity_share_pct: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. 51.00"
                />
              </Field>
            )}
            <Field label={t("Supply Chain Segment")}>
              {select(
                "segment",
                handleFacilityChange,
                SEGMENTS.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s} value={s}>
                    {t(s)}
                  </option>
                )),
                t("Select Segment"),
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Latitude")}>
              <Input
                type="number"
                step="any"
                name="latitude"
                value={facilityForm.latitude || ""}
                onChange={handleFacilityChange}
                placeholder="e.g. 33.8"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("Longitude")}>
              <Input
                type="number"
                step="any"
                name="longitude"
                value={facilityForm.longitude || ""}
                onChange={handleFacilityChange}
                placeholder="e.g. 6.07"

          const co2_u = Math.sqrt(

          const ch4_u = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(workbench.meter_precision, 2) + Math.pow(50.0, 2));

            <th>CO2</th>

            <th>N2O</th>
            <th>{t("Certification / Description")}</th>

            <th>{t("CHâ‚„ Unc.")}</th>
            <th>{t("Nâ‚‚O Unc.")}</th>
            <th>{t("Status")}</th>
            <th>{t("Actions")}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {filteredFactors
            .slice((currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE, currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE)
            .map((f) => (
              <tr key={f.id}>
                <td>

                <td>{f.unit}</td>
                <td>{f.co2_factor}</td>
                <td>{f.ch4_factor}</td>
                <td>{f.n2o_factor}</td>

                    <span className="inline-block! text-[length:0.75rem]! bg-[color:var(--color-legacy-dbeafe)]! text-[color:var(--color-blue-700)]! p-[1px_6px]! rounded-[4px]! font-semibold! mb-[2px]!">
                      {f.source}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {f.description && (
                    <div
                      className="text-[length:0.75rem]! text-[color:var(--text-secondary)]! overflow-hidden! [text-overflow:ellipsis]! whitespace-nowrap!"
                      title={f.description}
                    >
                      {f.description}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {!f.source && !f.description && (
                    <span className="text-[color:var(--text-secondary)]!">â€”</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className={f.co2_uncertainty ? "[color:var(--color-green-700)]!" : "[color:inherit]!"}>
                  {f.co2_uncertainty ? `Â±${f.co2_uncertainty}%` : "â€”"}
                </td>
                <td className={f.ch4_uncertainty ? "[color:var(--color-blue-700)]!" : "[color:inherit]!"}>
                  {f.ch4_uncertainty ? `Â±${f.ch4_uncertainty}%` : "â€”"}
                </td>
                <td className={f.n2o_uncertainty ? "[color:var(--color-violet-700)]!" : "[color:inherit]!"}>
                  {f.n2o_uncertainty ? `Â±${f.n2o_uncertainty}%` : "â€”"}
                </td>
                <td>
                  {f.status === "Pending" ? (
                    <span className="inline-block! text-[length:0.75rem]! bg-[color:var(--color-legacy-fef3c7)]! text-[color:var(--color-legacy-92400e)]! p-[2px_8px]! rounded-[4px]! font-semibold!">
                      {t("Pending")}
                    </span>
                  ) : f.status === "Rejected" ? (
                    <span className="inline-block! text-[length:0.75rem]! bg-[color:var(--color-legacy-fee2e2)]! text-[color:var(--color-red-700)]! p-[2px_8px]! rounded-[4px]! font-semibold!">
                      {t("Rejected")}

                  ) : (

                      {t("Approved")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>
                  {user?.role === "admin" && f.status === "Pending" && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleApproveFactor && handleApproveFactor(f.id)}
                      className="text-[color:var(--color-legacy-15803d)]! font-semibold! mr-[6px]!"
                      title={t("Approve custom factor")}
                    >
                      {t("Approve")}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button onClick={() => handleEditFactor(f)}>{t("Edit")}</button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleArchiveFactor(f.id)}
                    title={t("Hide from new entries; records that use it keep it")}
                  >
                    {t("Archive")}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => handleDeleteFactor(f.id)}>{t("Delete")}</button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          {filteredFactors.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={11} className="text-center! p-[40px]! text-[color:var(--text-secondary)]!">
                {t("No custom emission factors found.")}
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <PaginationControls
        currentPage={currentPage}
        totalItems={filteredFactors.length}
        itemsPerPage={ITEMS_PER_PAGE}
        onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
      />
    </div>
  </div>

interface ComponentItem {

interface SurveyItem {
  id: number;
  facility_id: number;
  facility_name?: string;
  component_inventory_id?: number;
  survey_method: string;

  measured_emission_rate?: number;

  leaking_hours?: number;
  surveyor_name?: string;
  notes?: string;
}

export const LdarTab: React.FC<LdarTabProps> = ({
  facilities,

  filterDivision = "",
  filterRegion = "",
}) => {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<"surveys" | "components">("surveys");
  const [surveys, setSurveys] = useState<SurveyItem[]>([]);

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("all");

  const [componentStatusFilter, setComponentStatusFilter] = useState<string>("all");

  // Selection states for bulk actions

  const [selectedCompIds, setSelectedCompIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  const handleSaveComponent = async () => {

      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post("/ldar/components", {

        equipment_type: compModal.equipment_type,
        component_type: compModal.component_type,

      setCompModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));

    };
    if (bulkCompModal.status) payload.status = bulkCompModal.status;
    if (bulkCompModal.service_type) payload.service_type = bulkCompModal.service_type;
    if (bulkCompModal.operating_hours) {
      const hrs = parseFloat(bulkCompModal.operating_hours);
      if (!isNaN(hrs)) payload.operating_hours = hrs;
    }

    if (!payload.status && !payload.service_type && payload.operating_hours === undefined) {
      toast.show(t("Please select at least one attribute to update"), "warning");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await api.post("/ldar/components/bulk-update", payload);
      toast.show(
        t("Successfully updated {{count}} components", {
          count: res.data?.updated_count || selectedCompIds.size,
        }),
        "success"
      );
      setBulkCompModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
      setSelectedCompIds(new Set());
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDeleteComponents = async () => {
    if (selectedCompIds.size === 0) return;
    if (
      !window.confirm(
        t("Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected components?", {
          count: selectedCompIds.size,
        })
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await api.post("/ldar/components/bulk-delete", {
        ids: Array.from(selectedCompIds),
      });
      toast.show(
        t("Successfully deleted {{count}} components", {
          count: res.data?.deleted_count || selectedCompIds.size,
        }),
        "success"
      );
      setSelectedCompIds(new Set());
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  // Bulk Handlers for Surveys
  const handleBulkUpdateSurveys = async () => {
    if (selectedSurveyIds.size === 0) return;
    const payload: Record<string, any> = {
      ids: Array.from(selectedSurveyIds),
      leak_status: bulkSurveyModal.leak_status,
    };
    if (bulkSurveyModal.leak_status === "Repaired") {
      payload.repair_date = bulkSurveyModal.repairDate;
      payload.screening_value_ppm = parseFloat(bulkSurveyModal.postRepairPpm) || 0;
    }
    if (bulkSurveyModal.notes) {
      payload.notes = bulkSurveyModal.notes;
    }

    try {
      const res = await api.post("/ldar/surveys/bulk-update", payload);
      toast.show(
        t("Successfully updated {{count}} surveys", {
          count: res.data?.updated_count || selectedSurveyIds.size,
        }),
        "success"
      );
      setBulkSurveyModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
      setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set());
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDeleteSurveys = async () => {
    if (selectedSurveyIds.size === 0) return;
    if (
      !window.confirm(
        t("Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected surveys?", {
          count: selectedSurveyIds.size,
        })
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await api.post("/ldar/surveys/bulk-delete", {
        ids: Array.from(selectedSurveyIds),
      });
      toast.show(
        t("Successfully deleted {{count}} surveys", {
          count: res.data?.deleted_count || selectedSurveyIds.size,
        }),
        "success"
      );
      setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set());
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.show(apiError(err), "error");
    }
  };

  const surveyCounts = useMemo(() => {
    let leaking = 0;
    let repaired = 0;
    let nonLeaking = 0;
    surveys.forEach((s) => {
      if (s.leak_status === "Leaking") leaking++;
      else if (s.leak_status === "Repaired") repaired++;
      else nonLeaking++;
    });
    return { all: surveys.length, leaking, repaired, nonLeaking };
  }, [surveys]);

  const surveyStatusOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: t("All Statuses"), count: surveyCounts.all },
    { value: "Leaking", label: t("Leaking"), count: surveyCounts.leaking, tone: "danger" as const },
    { value: "Repaired", label: t("Repaired"), count: surveyCounts.repaired, tone: "success" as const },
    { value: "Non-leaking", label: t("Non-leaking"), count: surveyCounts.nonLeaking },
  ];

  const surveyMethodOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: t("All Methods") },
    { value: "Method 21", label: t("Method 21") },
    { value: "OGI", label: t("OGI") },
    { value: "Acoustic", label: t("Acoustic") },
  ];

  const compEquipmentOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: t("All Equipment") },
    { value: "Valves", label: t("Valves") },
    { value: "Flanges", label: t("Flanges") },
    { value: "Pumps", label: t("Pumps") },
    { value: "Compressors", label: t("Compressors") },
    { value: "Relief Valves", label: t("Relief Valves") },
  ];

  const compStatusOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: t("All Statuses") },
    { value: "Active", label: t("Active") },
    { value: "Broken", label: t("Broken") },
    { value: "Leaking", label: t("Leaking") },
    { value: "Inactive", label: t("Inactive") },
  ];

  const getComponentStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const s = (status || "Active").toLowerCase();
    if (s === "broken" || s === "leaking" || s === "damaged" || s === "faulty") {
      return (
        <Badge tone="danger" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-3" />
          {t(status)}
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (s === "active") {
      return <Badge tone="success">{t("Active")}</Badge>;
    }
    return <Badge tone="neutral">{t(status || "Inactive")}</Badge>;
  };

  const filteredSurveys = useMemo(() => {
    return surveys.filter((s) => {
      const fac = facilities.find((f) => f.id === s.facility_id);
      const facName = s.facility_name || fac?.name || `Facility #${s.facility_id}`;

      if (filterRegion && filterRegion !== "all") {
        const facRegion = fac?.region_identifier || fac?.location || "";
        if (facRegion !== filterRegion && !facRegion.includes(filterRegion)) return false;
      }
      if (filterActivity) {
        if (!fac?.activity || fac.activity !== filterActivity) return false;
      }
      if (filterDivision) {
        if (!fac?.division || fac.division !== filterDivision) return false;
      }
      if (searchTerm) {
        const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matches =
          facName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (s.survey_method || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (s.surveyor_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (s.notes || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (s.survey_date || "").includes(term);
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      if (statusFilter !== "all" && s.leak_status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (methodFilter !== "all" && s.survey_method !== methodFilter) return false;

      return true;
    });
  }, [surveys, facilities, filterRegion, filterActivity, filterDivision, searchTerm, statusFilter, methodFilter]);

  const filteredComponents = useMemo(() => {
    return components.filter((c) => {
      const fac = facilities.find((f) => f.id === c.facility_id);
      const facName = c.facility_name || fac?.name || `Facility #${c.facility_id}`;

      if (filterRegion && filterRegion !== "all") {
        const facRegion = fac?.region_identifier || fac?.location || "";
        if (facRegion !== filterRegion && !facRegion.includes(filterRegion)) return false;
      }
      if (filterActivity) {
        if (!fac?.activity || fac.activity !== filterActivity) return false;
      }
      if (filterDivision) {
        if (!fac?.division || fac.division !== filterDivision) return false;
      }
      if (searchTerm) {
        const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matches =
          facName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.equipment_type || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.component_type || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.service_type || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(term);
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      if (equipmentFilter !== "all" && c.equipment_type !== equipmentFilter) return false;
      if (componentStatusFilter !== "all" && (c.status || "Active") !== componentStatusFilter) return false;

      return true;
    });
  }, [components, facilities, filterRegion, filterActivity, filterDivision, searchTerm, equipmentFilter, componentStatusFilter]);

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    if (status === "Leaking") {
      return (
        <Badge tone="danger" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-3" />
          {t("Leaking")}
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (status === "Repaired") {
      return (
        <Badge tone="success" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <CheckCircle className="size-3" />
          {t("Repaired")}
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    return <Badge tone="neutral">{t(status || "Non-leaking")}</Badge>;
  };

  const isAllSurveysSelected =
    filteredSurveys.length > 0 &&
    filteredSurveys.every((s) => selectedSurveyIds.has(s.id));

  const toggleSelectAllSurveys = () => {
    if (isAllSurveysSelected) {
      setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set(filteredSurveys.map((s) => s.id)));
    }
  };

  const toggleSurveySelection = (id: number) => {
    setSelectedSurveyIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const isAllCompsSelected =
    filteredComponents.length > 0 &&
    filteredComponents.every((c) => selectedCompIds.has(c.id));

  const toggleSelectAllComps = () => {
    if (isAllCompsSelected) {
      setSelectedCompIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedCompIds(new Set(filteredComponents.map((c) => c.id)));
    }
  };

  const toggleCompSelection = (id: number) => {
    setSelectedCompIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSwitchTab = (tab: "surveys" | "components") => {
    setActiveSubTab(tab);
    setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set());
    setSelectedCompIds(new Set());
  };

  return (
    <TabCard
      title={t("LDAR & Fugitive Leak Management")}
      description={t(
        "Track leak detection surveys (EPA Method 21 / OGI) and manage component inventories with leak repair workflow.",
      )}
      actions={
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {/* Subtab Segmented Switcher */}
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-100 p-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSwitchTab("surveys")}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer border-0",
                activeSubTab === "surveys"
                  ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
              )}
            >
              <span>{t("Surveys & Repairs")}</span>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold transition-colors",
                  activeSubTab === "surveys"
                    ? "bg-ink-100 text-text"
                    : "bg-ink-200/70 text-text-secondary"
                )}
              >
                {filteredSurveys.length}
              </span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSwitchTab("components")}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer border-0",
                activeSubTab === "components"
                  ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
              )}
            >
              <span>{t("Component Inventory")}</span>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold transition-colors",
                  activeSubTab === "components"
                    ? "bg-ink-100 text-text"
                    : "bg-ink-200/70 text-text-secondary"
                )}
              >
                {filteredComponents.length}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {activeSubTab === "surveys" ? (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              onClick={() =>
                setSurveyModal((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  isOpen: true,
                  facility_id: facilities[0]?.id ? String(facilities[0].id) : "",
                }))
              }
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs"
            >
              <Plus className="size-4" />
              {t("Record Survey")}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              onClick={() =>
                setCompModal((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  isOpen: true,
                  facility_id: facilities[0]?.id ? String(facilities[0].id) : "",
                }))
              }
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs"
            >
              <Plus className="size-4" />
              {t("Add Component")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      }
    >
      {activeSubTab === "surveys" ? (
        <>
          {/* Segmented Filter Pills */}
          <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-ink-50/50 p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              {/* Leak Status */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                  {t("Status")}:
                </span>
                <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-100 p-1">
                  {surveyStatusOptions.map((opt) => {
                    const active = statusFilter === opt.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setStatusFilter(opt.value)}
                        className={cn(
                          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer border-0",
                          active
                            ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
                        )}
                      >
                        {opt.tone === "danger" && (
                          <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-danger-fg" />
                        )}
                        {opt.tone === "success" && (
                          <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success-fg" />
                        )}
                        <span>{opt.label}</span>
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px]",
                            active
                              ? "bg-ink-100 text-text font-bold"
                              : "bg-ink-200/60 text-text-secondary font-medium"
                          )}
                        >
                          {opt.count}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Method */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                  {t("Method")}:
                </span>
                <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-100 p-1">
                  {surveyMethodOptions.map((opt) => {
                    const active = methodFilter === opt.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setMethodFilter(opt.value)}
                        className={cn(
                          "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer border-0",
                          active
                            ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
                        )}
                      >
                        {opt.label}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {(statusFilter !== "all" || methodFilter !== "all") && (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setStatusFilter("all");
                  setMethodFilter("all");
                }}
                className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="size-3 mr-1" />
                {t("Reset")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Survey Bulk Action Bar */}
          {selectedSurveyIds.size > 0 && (
            <div
              role="region"
              aria-label={t("Survey bulk actions")}
              className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/80 p-3 shadow-2xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CheckSquare className="size-4 text-brand-600" />
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-brand-900">
                  {t("{{count}} survey(s) selected", { count: selectedSurveyIds.size })}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setBulkSurveyModal({
                      isOpen: true,
                      leak_status: "Repaired",
                      repairDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
                      postRepairPpm: "0",
                      notes: "",
                    })
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <Wrench className="size-3.5" />
                  {t("Bulk Mark Repaired / Update")}
                </Button>
                {isPrivileged && (
                  <Button
                    variant="danger"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handleBulkDeleteSurveys}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
                    {t("Bulk Delete")}
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedSurveyIds(new Set())}
                  className="text-text-secondary hover:text-text text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  {t("Deselect All")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <RecordTable
            title={t("Fugitive Leak Surveys")}
            head={[
              <input
                key="select-all-surveys"
                type="checkbox"
                aria-label={t("Select all surveys")}
                checked={isAllSurveysSelected}
                onChange={toggleSelectAllSurveys}
                className="size-4 rounded border-border text-brand-600 focus:ring-brand-500 cursor-pointer"
              />,
              t("Facility"),
              t("Date"),
              t("Method"),
              t("Screening (PPM)"),
              t("Leak Status"),
              t("Repair Date"),
              t("Duration (hrs)"),
              t("Actions"),
            ]}
            empty={loading ? t("Loading surveys...") : t("No LDAR surveys recorded yet.")}
          >
            {filteredSurveys.map((s) => (
              <Tr key={s.id} className={selectedSurveyIds.has(s.id) ? "bg-brand-50/30" : undefined}>
                <Td className="w-10">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    aria-label={`Select survey ${s.id}`}
                    checked={selectedSurveyIds.has(s.id)}
                    onChange={() => toggleSurveySelection(s.id)}
                    className="size-4 rounded border-border text-brand-600 focus:ring-brand-500 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </Td>
                <Td className="font-medium text-text">
                  {s.facility_name || facilities.find((f) => f.id === s.facility_id)?.name || s.facility_id}
                </Td>
                <Td>{s.survey_date}</Td>
                <Td>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-ink-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">
                    {s.survey_method}
                  </span>
                </Td>
                <Td className="font-mono">
                  {s.screening_value_ppm !== undefined && s.screening_value_ppm !== null
                    ? `${s.screening_value_ppm.toLocaleString()} ppm`
                    : "-"}
                </Td>
                <Td>{getStatusBadge(s.leak_status)}</Td>
                <Td>{s.repair_date || "-"}</Td>
                <Td className="font-mono">{s.leaking_hours !== undefined ? s.leaking_hours : 8760}</Td>
                <Td>
                  {s.leak_status === "Leaking" && (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenRepairModal(s)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-brand-300 bg-brand-50/70 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-700 shadow-2xs hover:bg-brand-100 hover:border-brand-400 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Wrench className="size-3.5 text-brand-600" />
                      {t("Mark Repaired")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {s.leak_status === "Repaired" && (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-success-fg">
                      <CheckCircle className="size-3.5" />
                      {t("Completed")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {s.leak_status !== "Leaking" && s.leak_status !== "Repaired" && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-secondary">-</span>
                  )}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </RecordTable>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Component Inventory Segmented Filters */}
          <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-ink-50/50 p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              {/* Equipment */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                  {t("Equipment")}:
                </span>
                <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-100 p-1">
                  {compEquipmentOptions.map((opt) => {
                    const active = equipmentFilter === opt.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setEquipmentFilter(opt.value)}
                        className={cn(
                          "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer border-0",
                          active
                            ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
                        )}
                      >
                        {opt.label}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary">
                  {t("Status")}:
                </span>
                <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-ink-100 p-1">
                  {compStatusOptions.map((opt) => {
                    const active = componentStatusFilter === opt.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setComponentStatusFilter(opt.value)}
                        className={cn(
                          "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer border-0",
                          active
                            ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text hover:bg-surface/50"
                        )}
                      >
                        {opt.label}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {(equipmentFilter !== "all" || componentStatusFilter !== "all") && (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setEquipmentFilter("all");
                  setComponentStatusFilter("all");
                }}
                className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="size-3 mr-1" />
                {t("Reset")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Component Bulk Action Bar */}
          {selectedCompIds.size > 0 && (
            <div
              role="region"
              aria-label={t("Component bulk actions")}
              className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/80 p-3 shadow-2xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CheckSquare className="size-4 text-brand-600" />
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-brand-900">

export interface RecordTableProps {

  head: React.ReactNode[];
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  empty?: React.ReactNode;
  colSpan?: number;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;

/** Titled, horizontally scrollable table block. Pass the header labels and the body rows. */
export const RecordTable: React.FC<RecordTableProps> = ({
  title,
  head,
  children,
  empty,
  colSpan,
  footer,
  className,
}) => (
  <div className={cn("table-container mt-10", className)}>
    {title && <h3 className="m-0 mb-3 text-lg font-semibold text-text">{title}</h3>}
    {/* Focusable so keyboard users can scroll a wide table (axe scrollable-region-focusable). */}
    <div
      className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border"
      tabIndex={0}
      role="region"
      aria-label={typeof title === "string" ? title : t("Records")}
    >
      <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-base">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {head.map((h, i) => (
              <th key={i} scope="col" className="whitespace-nowrap border-b border-border bg-ink-50 px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-text-secondary">
                {h}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {children}
          {empty && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={colSpan || head.length} className="p-10 text-center text-text-secondary">
                {empty}
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    {footer}
  </div>
);

const labelWithAuto = (text: React.ReactNode, auto?: boolean) => (

    {text}

export interface ScopeFieldsProps {
  form: {
    activity?: string;
    division?: string;
    facility_id?: string | number;
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  setForm: (form: any) => void;
  isPrivileged?: boolean;
  facilities: Array<{
    id: string | number;
    name: string;
    field?: string;
    activity?: string;
    division?: string;
    [key: string]: any;
  }>;
  ACTIVITY_LABELS: Record<string, string>;
  getAvailableActivities: () => string[];
  getAvailableDivisions: (activity?: string) => string[];
}

/**
 * Activity, Division and Region selectors shared by the production, source and mitigation forms.
 * Non-privileged users with a single option get it pre-selected, so the field is locked and tagged "Auto".
 */
export const ScopeFields: React.FC<ScopeFieldsProps> = ({
  form,
  setForm,
  isPrivileged,
  facilities,
  ACTIVITY_LABELS,
  getAvailableActivities,
  getAvailableDivisions,
}) => {
  const activities = getAvailableActivities();
  const divisions = getAvailableDivisions(form.activity);
  const regions = facilities.filter((f) => f.activity === form.activity && f.division === form.division);
  const lockActivity = !isPrivileged && activities.length === 1;
  const lockDivision = !isPrivileged && divisions.length === 1;
  const lockRegion = !isPrivileged && regions.length === 1;
  return (
    <>
      <Field label={labelWithAuto("Activity", lockActivity)}>
        <NativeSelect className={controlClass} value={form.activity || ""} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, activity: e.target.value, division: "", facility_id: "" })} disabled={lockActivity}>
          <option value="">{t("Select Activity")}</option>
          {activities.map((a) => (
            <option key={a} value={a}>
              {ACTIVITY_LABELS[a] || a}
            </option>
          ))}
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
      <Field label={labelWithAuto("Division", lockDivision)}>
        <NativeSelect className={controlClass} value={form.division || ""} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, division: e.target.value, facility_id: "" })} disabled={!form.activity || lockDivision}>
          <option value="">{t("Select Division")}</option>
          {divisions.map((d) => (
            <option key={d} value={d}>
              {d}
            </option>
          ))}
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-text">{labelWithAuto("Region", lockRegion)}</span>
        <CustomDropdown
          options={[{ value: "", label: t("Select Region") }, ...regions.map((f) => ({ value: f.id.toString(), label: f.name, subLabel: f.field }))]}
          value={form.facility_id != null ? String(form.facility_id) : ""}
          onChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, facility_id: val })}
          placeholder={t("Select Region")}
          disabled={!form.division || lockRegion}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

  name?: string;
  mitigation_type?: string;
  activity?: string;
  region?: string;
  division?: string;
  year?: number | string;
  type?: string;
  status?: string;
  quantity_tco2e: number | string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export interface MitigationTabProps {
  ACTIVITY_LABELS: Record<string, string>;
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE: number;
  currentPage: number;
  facilities: Array<{
    id: string | number;
    name: string;
    field?: string;
    activity?: string;
    division?: string;
    [key: string]: any;
  }>;
  filteredMitigations: MitigationRecord[];
  getAvailableActivities: () => string[];
  getAvailableDivisions: (activity?: string) => string[];
  handleDeleteMitigation: (id: string | number) => void;
  handleSaveMitigation: () => void;
  isPrivileged: boolean;
  mitigationForm: Record<string, any>;
  mitigations: MitigationRecord[];
  setCurrentPage: (page: number) => void;
  setImportModal: (modal: { isOpen: boolean; type: string }) => void;
  setMitigationForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any>>;
}

        itemsPerPage={ITEMS_PER_PAGE}
