@emissions_bp.route("/pending", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_pending_emissions():
    """Get all pending emissions across Scope 1, 2, 3 for the reviewer dashboard.
    Query params: ?all=true (unlimited) or ?limit=200
    """
    user = get_current_user()
    if not user or user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Insufficient permissions"}), 403

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    # drafts are the maker's unsubmitted work: they enter review only when submitted (browser test)
    from services.maker_checker import REVIEWABLE_STATUSES

    pending_statuses = list(REVIEWABLE_STATUSES)  # what the queue shows is what can be decided
    fetch_all = request.args.get("all", "").lower() == "true"
    if fetch_all:
        limit_val = None
    else:
        try:
            limit_val = max(1, min(1000, int(request.args.get("limit", 200))))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            limit_val = 200

    def _format_s1_ef(e):
        parts = []
        if getattr(e, "ef_used_co2", None) is not None:
            parts.append(f"CO2: {e.ef_used_co2:.4g}")
        if getattr(e, "ef_used_ch4", None) is not None and e.ef_used_ch4 > 0:
            parts.append(f"CH4: {e.ef_used_ch4:.4g}")
        if getattr(e, "ef_used_n2o", None) is not None and e.ef_used_n2o > 0:
            parts.append(f"N2O: {e.ef_used_n2o:.4g}")
        if parts:
            return ", ".join(parts)
        return getattr(e, "calc_method", None) or "Default"

    def q_scope1():
        q = Emission.query.filter(Emission.status.in_(pending_statuses))
        if allowed_fids is not None:
            q = q.filter(Emission.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
        q = q.order_by(Emission.timestamp.desc())
        if limit_val:
            q = q.limit(limit_val)
        return [
            {
                "id": e.id, "scope": "1", "facility_id": e.facility_id,
                "facility_name": e.facility.name if getattr(e, "facility", None) else None,
                "year": e.year, "month": e.month, "process_type": e.process_type,
                "fuel_type": e.fuel_type, "quantity": e.quantity, "unit": e.unit,
                "co2e_total": e.co2e_total, "status": e.status, 
                "qa_flag": getattr(e, "qa_flag", None),
                "emission_factor": _format_s1_ef(e),
                "created_by": getattr(e, "created_by", None),
                "created_at": e.timestamp.isoformat() if e.timestamp else None,
            }
            for e in q.all()
        ]

    def q_scope2():
        q = Scope2Emission.query.filter(Scope2Emission.status.in_(pending_statuses))
        if allowed_fids is not None:
            q = q.filter(Scope2Emission.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
        q = q.order_by(Scope2Emission.created_at.desc())
        if limit_val:
            q = q.limit(limit_val)
        return [
            {
                "id": e.id, "scope": "2", "facility_id": e.facility_id,
                "facility_name": e.facility.name if getattr(e, "facility", None) else None,
                "year": e.year, "month": e.month, "source_type": e.source_type,
                "electricity_kwh": e.electricity_kwh, "heat_mmbtu": getattr(e, "heat_mmbtu", None),
                "co2e": e.co2e, "status": e.status,
                "qa_flag": getattr(e, "qa_flag", None),
                "emission_factor": getattr(e, "emission_factor", None),
                "created_by": getattr(e, "created_by", None),
                "created_at": e.created_at.isoformat() if e.created_at else None,
            }
            for e in q.all()
        ]

    def q_scope3():
        q = Scope3Emission.query.filter(Scope3Emission.status.in_(pending_statuses))
        if allowed_fids is not None:
            q = q.filter(Scope3Emission.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
        q = q.order_by(Scope3Emission.created_at.desc())
        if limit_val:
            q = q.limit(limit_val)
        return [
            {
                "id": e.id, "scope": "3", "facility_id": e.facility_id,
                "facility_name": e.facility.name if getattr(e, "facility", None) else None,
                "year": e.year, "month": e.month, "category": e.category,
                "sub_category": getattr(e, "sub_category", None),
                "activity_data": getattr(e, "activity_data", None),
                "unit": getattr(e, "unit", None),
                "co2e": e.co2e, "status": e.status,
                "qa_flag": getattr(e, "qa_flag", None),
                "emission_factor": getattr(e, "emission_factor", None),
                "created_by": getattr(e, "created_by", None),
                "created_at": e.created_at.isoformat() if e.created_at else None,
            }
            for e in q.all()
        ]

    def count_pending(model):
        q = model.query.filter(model.status.in_(pending_statuses))
        if allowed_fids is not None:
            q = q.filter(model.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
        return q.count()

    counts = {
        "1": count_pending(Emission),
        "2": count_pending(Scope2Emission),
        "3": count_pending(Scope3Emission),
    }

    def sum_pending(model, col):
        q = db.session.query(db.func.coalesce(db.func.sum(col), 0.0)).filter(model.status.in_(pending_statuses))
        if allowed_fids is not None:
            q = q.filter(model.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
        return float(q.scalar() or 0.0)

    pending_co2e = (sum_pending(Emission, Emission.co2e_total) + sum_pending(Scope2Emission, Scope2Emission.co2e)
                    + sum_pending(Scope3Emission, Scope3Emission.co2e))
    return jsonify({
        "scope1": q_scope1(),
        "scope2": q_scope2(),
        "scope3": q_scope3(),
        # the lists hold at most `limit` rows per scope; the counts are the whole queue
        "pending_counts": counts,
        "pending_co2e": pending_co2e,
        "limit": limit_val,
        "total_pending": sum(counts.values()),
    })

def _parse_date(value, field, required=True):
    import datetime as _dt
    from input_validation import ValidationError

    if value in (None, ""):
        if required:
            raise ValidationError(f"'{field}' is required", field)
        return None
    try:
        return _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10])
    except ValueError:
        raise ValidationError(f"'{field}' must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)", field)


def _overlap_days(start, end, lo, hi):
    """Inclusive day overlap between [start, end or +inf] and [lo, hi]."""
    s = max(start, lo)
    e = min(end or hi, hi)
    return max(0, (e - s).days + 1)


def effective_share_pct(slices, year, month=None):
    """BUG-046: time-weighted equity % of one partner over a calendar year (or one month of it).

    `slices` are FacilityEquityShare rows for one facility/partner. Each slice counts for the
    days of the period it covers; days no slice covers contribute nothing. Returns None when no
    slice overlaps the period (caller decides the fallback).
    """
    import calendar
    import datetime as _dt

    if month:
        lo, hi = _dt.date(year, month, 1), _dt.date(year, month, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1])
    else:
        lo, hi = _dt.date(year, 1, 1), _dt.date(year, 12, 31)
    days_in_period = (hi - lo).days + 1
    total, covered = 0.0, 0
    for sl in slices:
        try:
            start = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(sl.effective_start_date)[:10])
            end = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(sl.effective_end_date)[:10]) if sl.effective_end_date else None
        except ValueError:
            continue
        d = _overlap_days(start, end, lo, hi)
        if d:
            total += float(sl.equity_share_pct or 0.0) * d
            covered += d
    if not covered:
        return None
    return total / days_in_period


def _partner_pcts(fac, partners, slices_by_partner, year, month=None):
    """Equity % of every partner for the period. Audit 2026-10-14 BUG-0004: an operator without its
    own share row holds what the explicit partner shares leave (at most the facility's equity %),
    not 100 % on top of them."""
    explicit = {p.id: effective_share_pct(slices_by_partner[p.id], year, month) for p in partners}
    explicit_sum = sum(v for v in explicit.values() if v is not None)
    out = {}
    for p in partners:
        pct = explicit[p.id]
        if pct is None:
            pct = (min(float(fac.equity_share_pct or 0.0), max(0.0, 100.0 - explicit_sum))
                   if p.is_operator else 0.0)
        out[p.id] = pct
    return out


@equity_bp.route("/shares", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def save_equity_share():
    from input_validation import parse_number

    user = get_current_user()
    # BUG-046: ownership is organisation configuration, not operational data entry
    if not user or user.role not in ("admin", "superuser"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: only administrators and super users can change equity shares"}), 403
    data = request.get_json() or {}

    facility_id = int(parse_number(data.get("facility_id"), "facility_id", min_value=1))
    partner_id = int(parse_number(data.get("partner_id"), "partner_id", min_value=1))
    equity_pct = parse_number(data.get("equity_share_pct"), "equity_share_pct", min_value=0, max_value=100)

    if not require_facility_access(user, facility_id):
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: You do not have access to this facility"}), 403
    if db.session.get(Facility, facility_id) is None:
        return jsonify({"error": f"Facility with ID {facility_id} does not exist"}), 404
    if db.session.get(JvPartner, partner_id) is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unknown partner"}), 400

    start = _parse_date(data.get("effective_start_date") or "2021-01-01", "effective_start_date")
    end = _parse_date(data.get("effective_end_date"), "effective_end_date", required=False)
    if end is not None and end < start:
        return jsonify({"error": "effective_end_date must not be before effective_start_date"}), 400

    share_id = data.get("id")
    if share_id:
        share = FacilityEquityShare.query.filter_by(id=int(share_id), facility_id=facility_id).first()
    else:
        share = FacilityEquityShare.query.filter_by(
            facility_id=facility_id, partner_id=partner_id, effective_start_date=start.isoformat()
        ).first()

    # Shares of all partners that overlap this period must not exceed 100 %
    import datetime as _dt

    far = _dt.date(9999, 12, 31)
    others = []
    for other in FacilityEquityShare.query.filter_by(facility_id=facility_id).all():
        if share is not None and other.id == share.id:
            continue
        o_start = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(other.effective_start_date)[:10])
        o_end = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(other.effective_end_date)[:10]) if other.effective_end_date else far
        if o_start <= (end or far) and start <= o_end:
            others.append((o_start, o_end, float(other.equity_share_pct or 0.0)))
    # the concurrent total can only change at a slice start, so check each start inside the period
    checkpoints = {start} | {o[0] for o in others if start <= o[0] <= (end or far)}
    pct_sum = max(
        equity_pct + sum(p for (o_s, o_e, p) in others if o_s <= day <= o_e) for day in checkpoints
    )
    if pct_sum > 100.0 + 1e-9:
        return jsonify({"error": f"Equity shares overlapping this period would total {pct_sum:.2f}% (max 100%)"}), 400

    if not share:
        share = FacilityEquityShare(facility_id=facility_id, partner_id=partner_id, effective_start_date=start.isoformat())
        db.session.add(share)
    else:
        share.effective_start_date = start.isoformat()

    share.equity_share_pct = equity_pct
    share.effective_end_date = end.isoformat() if end else None
    share.agreement_reference = data.get("agreement_reference")

    from utils import log_activity_and_notify
    from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache

    log_activity_and_notify(action="UPDATE", record_id=f"equity-{facility_id}-{partner_id}", user=user, request=request,
                            entity="FacilityEquityShare", facility_id=facility_id,
                            details=f"Equity share {equity_pct}% for partner {partner_id} from {start} to {end or 'open'}")
    db.session.commit()
    clear_dashboard_cache()
    return jsonify({"success": True, "id": share.id, "message": "Equity share saved successfully"})

@equity_bp.route("/allocation", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_equity_allocation():
    """
    Allocates annual GHG (Scope 1 + Scope 2 tCO2e) and methane (tCH4) emissions to JV partners
    based on their effective equity share percentages.
    """
    ensure_default_partners()
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["it", "it_admin", "it_manager"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: IT roles do not have access to Joint Venture equity data"}), 403
    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)

    year = (request.args.get("year") or "").strip()
    yr = int(year) if year.isdigit() and 1900 <= int(year) <= 2100 else 2025  # malformed or out of range (F13): 2025

    facility_id = request.args.get("facility_id")
    fac_q = Facility.query
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        fac_q = fac_q.filter(Facility.id.in_(allowed_fids))
    if facility_id and facility_id != "all":
        try:
            fid = int(facility_id)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "facility_id must be a valid integer"}), 400
        if allowed_fids is not None and fid not in allowed_fids:
            return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized facility"}), 403
        fac_q = fac_q.filter(Facility.id == fid)

    facilities = fac_q.all()
    partners = JvPartner.query.order_by(JvPartner.name).all()

    # Get totals per facility
    allocation_by_facility = []

    for fac in facilities:
        # Audit 2026-10-14 BUG-0023: allocate month by month, so a share that changes mid-year
        # applies to the emissions of the months it covers (records without a month use the
        # year's time-weighted share)
        from models import Scope2Emission

        periods = {}  # month (or None) -> [scope 1 tCO2e, scope 2 tCO2e, tCH4]
        # verified emissions of this facility and year, per month
        for m, co2e, ch4 in db.session.query(
                Emission.month, db.func.sum(Emission.co2e_total), db.func.sum(Emission.ch4_emissions)
        ).filter(Emission.facility_id == fac.id, Emission.year == yr, Emission.status == "Verified"
                 ).group_by(Emission.month).all():
            row = periods.setdefault(m if m in range(1, 13) else None, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
            row[0] += float(co2e or 0.0)
            row[2] += float(ch4 or 0.0)
        # GHG Protocol equity-share approach: the partners take their share of the operation's
        # Scope 1 and Scope 2 (purchased energy); Scope 2 used to be left out
        for m, co2e in db.session.query(Scope2Emission.month, db.func.sum(Scope2Emission.co2e)).filter(
                Scope2Emission.facility_id == fac.id, Scope2Emission.year == yr,
                Scope2Emission.status == "Verified").group_by(Scope2Emission.month).all():
            periods.setdefault(m if m in range(1, 13) else None, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])[1] += float(co2e or 0.0)
        total_s1 = sum(v[0] for v in periods.values())
        total_s2 = sum(v[1] for v in periods.values())
        total_ch4 = sum(v[2] for v in periods.values())
        total_co2e = total_s1 + total_s2

        # BUG-046: time-weighted share of every slice that is effective during year yr
        shares = FacilityEquityShare.query.filter_by(facility_id=fac.id).all()
        by_partner = {p.id: [s for s in shares if s.partner_id == p.id] for p in partners}
        annual = _partner_pcts(fac, partners, by_partner, yr)
        alloc = {p.id: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] for p in partners}
        for m, amounts in periods.items():
            pcts = annual if m is None else _partner_pcts(fac, partners, by_partner, yr, m)
            for pid, pct in pcts.items():
                for i in range(3):
                    alloc[pid][i] += amounts[i] * pct / 100.0

        partner_allocations = []
        for p in partners:
            allocated_s1, allocated_s2, allocated_ch4 = alloc[p.id]
            allocated_co2e = allocated_s1 + allocated_s2

            partner_allocations.append({
                "partner_id": p.id,
                "partner_name": p.name,
                "partner_code": p.code,
                "equity_pct": round(annual[p.id], 4),
                "allocated_co2e": round(allocated_co2e, 2),
                "allocated_scope1": round(allocated_s1, 2),
                "allocated_scope2": round(allocated_s2, 2),
                "allocated_ch4": round(allocated_ch4, 2),
            })

        # DEFECT-AG1-06: GHG Protocol Chapter 3 - Unallocated working interest identification
        allocated_pct_sum = round(sum(p["equity_pct"] for p in partner_allocations), 4)
        unallocated_pct = round(max(0.0, 100.0 - allocated_pct_sum), 4)
        is_fully_allocated = bool(unallocated_pct <= 0.001)

        unallocated_s1 = round(max(0.0, total_s1 - sum(v[0] for v in alloc.values())), 2)
        unallocated_s2 = round(max(0.0, total_s2 - sum(v[1] for v in alloc.values())), 2)
        unallocated_co2e = round(unallocated_s1 + unallocated_s2, 2)
        unallocated_ch4 = round(max(0.0, total_ch4 - sum(v[2] for v in alloc.values())), 2)

        unallocated_share = None
        if not is_fully_allocated:
            unallocated_share = {
                "partner_id": None,
                "partner_name": "Unallocated Third-Party Interest",
                "partner_code": "THIRD_PARTY",
                "equity_pct": round(unallocated_pct, 2),
                "allocated_co2e": unallocated_co2e,
                "allocated_scope1": unallocated_s1,
                "allocated_scope2": unallocated_s2,
                "allocated_ch4": unallocated_ch4,
                "standards_reference": "GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 3 (Unallocated Working Interest)",
            }

        allocation_by_facility.append({
            "facility_id": fac.id,
            "facility_name": fac.name,
            "year": yr,
            "total_co2e": round(total_co2e, 2),
            "total_scope1": round(total_s1, 2),
            "total_scope2": round(total_s2, 2),
            "total_ch4": round(total_ch4, 2),
            "total_allocated_equity_pct": round(allocated_pct_sum, 2),
            "unallocated_equity_pct": round(unallocated_pct, 2),
            "unallocated_co2e": unallocated_co2e,
            "unallocated_scope1": unallocated_s1,
            "unallocated_scope2": unallocated_s2,
            "unallocated_ch4": unallocated_ch4,
            "is_fully_allocated": is_fully_allocated,
            "allocation_status": "Fully Allocated" if is_fully_allocated else f"Partial ({unallocated_pct:.2f}% unallocated third-party interest)",
            "ghg_protocol_boundary_note": "Consolidated joint venture interest fully allocated (100.0%)." if is_fully_allocated else f"Pursuant to GHG Protocol Chapter 3, unallocated equity ({unallocated_pct:.2f}%) represents external third-party or non-reporting operating partner interest.",
            "unallocated_share": unallocated_share,
            "partners": partner_allocations,
        })

    return jsonify(allocation_by_facility)

@facilities_bp.route("", methods=["GET"])
@facilities_bp.route("/", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_facilities():
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    user = (
        db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None
    )  # API-02 FIX: replaced deprecated query.get
    if not user:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 401
    if user.role in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return (
            jsonify(
                {"error": "Forbidden: IT personnel cannot access operational facility data"}
            ),
            403,
        )

    query = Facility.query
    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        query = query.filter(Facility.id.in_(allowed_fids))

    search_term = request.args.get("search")
    if search_term:
        escaped_search = search_term.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
        query = query.filter(Facility.name.ilike(f"%{escaped_search}%", escape="\\"))

    facilities = query.all()
    return jsonify(
        [
            {
                "id": f.id,
                "name": f.name,
                "location": f.location,
                "division": f.division,
                "activity": f.activity,
                "region": f.region,
                # Computed identifier: falls back to name when region is NULL.
                # Mirrors the 3-way match in utils.get_allowed_facility_ids().
                # All frontend dropdowns and filters MUST use this field instead
                # of reading f.region directly.
                "region_identifier": f.region or f.name,
                "boundary_notes": f.boundary_notes,
                "boundary_type": f.boundary_type or "Operational Control",
                "boundary_detail": f.boundary_detail or "",
                "equity_share_pct": f.equity_share_pct if f.equity_share_pct is not None else 100.0,
                "segment": f.segment,
                "operator_status": f.operator_status or "operated",
                "country": f.country or "Algeria",
                "ogmp_membership_year": f.ogmp_membership_year or 2023,
                "reconciliation_threshold": f.reconciliation_threshold or 20.0,
                "field": f.field,
                "latitude": f.latitude,
                "longitude": f.longitude,
            }
            for f in facilities
        ]
    )


@facilities_bp.route("/all-regions", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_all_regions():
    """
    Return all unique region identifiers â€” IT personnel only, no access filtering.

    Mirrors the fallback logic in utils.get_allowed_facility_ids():
      - Uses facility.region when set
      - Falls back to facility.name for facilities where region is NULL
    This ensures the values shown in the dropdown will always resolve to
    actual facilities when a user's location is matched later.
    """
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    caller = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None  # API-02 FIX
    if not caller or caller.role not in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "IT privileges required"}), 403

    identifiers = set()

    # 1. Facilities that have an explicit region value
    region_rows = (
        db.session.query(Facility.region)
        .filter(Facility.region.isnot(None), Facility.region != "")
        .distinct()
        .all()
    )
    for (r,) in region_rows:
        if r and r.strip():
            identifiers.add(r.strip())

    # 2. For facilities with no region set, fall back to their name
    #    (mirrors utils.py line 28: filter_by(name=user_region))
    name_rows = (
        db.session.query(Facility.name)
        .filter(
            db.or_(Facility.region.is_(None), Facility.region == ""),
            Facility.name.isnot(None),
            Facility.name != "",
        )
        .distinct()
        .all()
    )
    for (n,) in name_rows:
        if n and n.strip():
            identifiers.add(n.strip())

    return jsonify(sorted(identifiers))


def _parse_coordinates(data, current=(None, None)):
    """BUG-045: blank latitude/longitude means 'not set'; otherwise a number in range."""
    lat, lon = current
    if "latitude" in data:
        lat = parse_number(data.get("latitude"), "latitude", required=False, min_value=-90, max_value=90)
    if "longitude" in data:
        lon = parse_number(data.get("longitude"), "longitude", required=False, min_value=-180, max_value=180)
    return lat, lon


@facilities_bp.route("", methods=["POST"])
@facilities_bp.route("/", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def add_facility():
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None
    if not user:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 401
    if user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
        return (
            jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Only Administrators can create facilities"}),
            403,
        )

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    # BUG-029: a facility must have a non-empty name (NULL names crash the UI and bulk import).
    data["name"] = require_text(data.get("name"), "name")
    lat, lon = _parse_coordinates(data)

    if not facility_change_allowed(user, None, data.get("region"), data.get("location"), data.get("name")):
        return (
            jsonify(
                {"error": f"Superusers can only create facilities in their assigned region: {user.location}"}
            ),
            403,
        )

    code = data.get("code")
    if code:
        existing = Facility.query.filter_by(code=str(code).strip()).first()
        if existing:
            return jsonify({"error": f"Facility code '{code}' is already in use"}), 409

    fac = Facility(
        name=data.get("name"),
        location=data.get("location"),
        division=data.get("division"),
        activity=data.get("activity"),
        region=data.get("region"),
        field=data.get("field"),
        code=data.get("code"),
        boundary_notes=data.get("boundary_notes"),
        boundary_type=data.get("boundary_type", "Operational Control"),
        boundary_detail=data.get("boundary_detail"),
        equity_share_pct=parse_number(data.get("equity_share_pct"), "equity_share_pct", required=False, min_value=0, max_value=100, default=100.0),
        segment=data.get("segment"),
        operator_status=data.get("operator_status", "operated"),
        country=data.get("country", "Algeria"),
        ogmp_membership_year=parse_year(data.get("ogmp_membership_year"), required=False) or 2023,
        reconciliation_threshold=parse_number(
            data.get("reconciliation_threshold"), "reconciliation_threshold", required=False, min_value=0, max_value=1000, default=20.0
        ),
        latitude=lat,
        longitude=lon,
        description=data.get("description"),
    )

    try:
        db.session.add(fac)
        db.session.flush()  # Flush to get fac.id for audit log
    except IntegrityError:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Facility code '{fac.code}' is already in use"}), 409

    # Audit
    try:
        user_id = session.get("user_id")
        user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None

        log_details = (
            f"Created facility: {fac.name} (Code: {fac.code}, Segment: {fac.segment})"
        )

        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="CREATE",
            record_id=str(fac.id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="Facility",
            details=log_details,
            metadata_json=json.dumps(
                {
                    "name": fac.name,
                    "code": fac.code,
                    "segment": fac.segment,
                    "location": fac.location,
                }
            ),
        )
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        raise e

    try:
        from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
        clear_dashboard_cache()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return jsonify({"message": "Facility added", "id": fac.id}), 201

def update_facility(facility_id):

        facility.name = data["name"]
    if "location" in data:
        facility.location = data["location"]
    if "description" in data:
        facility.description = data["description"]
    if "boundary_notes" in data:
        facility.boundary_notes = data["boundary_notes"]
    if "boundary_type" in data:
        facility.boundary_type = data["boundary_type"]
    if "boundary_detail" in data:
        facility.boundary_detail = data["boundary_detail"]
    if "equity_share_pct" in data and data["equity_share_pct"] is not None:
        facility.equity_share_pct = parse_number(data["equity_share_pct"], "equity_share_pct", min_value=0, max_value=100)
    if "activity" in data:
        facility.activity = data["activity"]
    if "region" in data:
        facility.region = data["region"]
    if "division" in data:
        facility.division = data["division"]
    if "field" in data:
        facility.field = data["field"]
    if "code" in data:
        facility.code = data["code"]
    if "external_id" in data:
        facility.external_id = data["external_id"]
    if "segment" in data:
        facility.segment = data["segment"]
    if "operator_status" in data:
        facility.operator_status = data["operator_status"]
    if "country" in data:
        facility.country = data["country"]
    if "ogmp_membership_year" in data and data["ogmp_membership_year"] is not None:
        facility.ogmp_membership_year = parse_year(data["ogmp_membership_year"], required=False)
    if (
        "reconciliation_threshold" in data
        and data["reconciliation_threshold"] is not None
    ):
        facility.reconciliation_threshold = parse_number(data["reconciliation_threshold"], "reconciliation_threshold", min_value=0, max_value=1000)
    facility.latitude, facility.longitude = lat, lon

    import datetime

    facility.updated_at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    db.session.flush()

    # Audit
    try:
        user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None  # API-02 FIX

            k
            for k in data
            if k

                "boundary_detail",
                "activity",
                "division",
                "field",
                "code",
                "segment",
                "region",

            record_id=str(facility_id),
            user=user,

                    "new_values": {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in changes},
                }

        db.session.rollback()
        raise e

        from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache

        pass

def delete_facility(facility_id):
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None  # API-02 FIX
    if not user:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 401
    if user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Only Administrators can delete facilities"}), 403

    try:
        fid = int(facility_id)
        if fid <= 0 or fid > 2147483647:
            return jsonify({"error": "Facility not found"}), 404
    except (ValueError, OverflowError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Facility not found"}), 404

    if not facility:
        return jsonify({"error": "Facility not found"}), 404

    if allowed_fids is not None and facility.id not in allowed_fids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized: Outside your region"}), 403
    # Deleting the facility cascades to its records: the maker-checker rule for single records
    # (only an administrator deletes Verified records) applies to the cascade as well.
    if user.role != "admin":
        from models import Emission, Scope2Emission, Scope3Emission
        if any(m.query.filter_by(facility_id=facility.id, status="Verified").first()
               for m in (Emission, Scope2Emission, Scope3Emission)):
            return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: this facility has approved (Verified) records; "
                                     "only an administrator can delete it"}), 403

    try:
        db.session.delete(facility)
        db.session.flush()

        # Audit
        user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None  # API-02 FIX
        log_details = f"Deleted facility: {facility.name} (Code: {facility.code})"

        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="DELETE",
            record_id=str(facility_id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="Facility",
            details=log_details,
            metadata_json=json.dumps({"name": facility.name, "code": facility.code, "location": facility.location}),
        )
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        current_app.logger.exception("Failed to delete facility %s", facility_id)
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to delete facility"}), 500

    try:
        from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
        clear_dashboard_cache()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return jsonify({"message": "Facility deleted"})


@facilities_bp.route("/import", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def import_facilities():
    """Bulk import facilities"""
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    user = db.session.get(User, user_id) if user_id else None
    if not user:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 401
    if user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
        return (
            jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Only Administrators can bulk import facilities"}),
            403,
        )

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    facilities_data = data.get("facilities", [])

    if not facilities_data:
        return jsonify({"error": "No facilities provided"}), 400

    for i, fac_data in enumerate(facilities_data):
        fac_data["name"] = require_text(fac_data.get("name"), f"facilities[{i}].name")  # BUG-029
        if not facility_change_allowed(user, None, fac_data.get("region"), fac_data.get("location"), fac_data.get("name")):
            return (
                jsonify(
                    {
                        "error": f"Superusers can only import facilities in their assigned region: {user.location}"
                    }
                ),
                403,
            )

    imported_count = 0
    for fac_data in facilities_data:
        facility = Facility(
            name=fac_data.get("name"),
            location=fac_data.get("location"),
            description=fac_data.get("description"),
            boundary_notes=fac_data.get("boundary_notes"),
            boundary_type=fac_data.get("boundary_type", "Operational Control"),
            boundary_detail=fac_data.get("boundary_detail"),
            activity=fac_data.get("activity"),
            division=fac_data.get("division"),
            region=fac_data.get("region"),
            field=fac_data.get("field"),
            code=fac_data.get("code"),
            external_id=fac_data.get("external_id"),
            segment=fac_data.get("segment"),
            created_by=user_id,
        )
        db.session.add(facility)
        imported_count += 1

    try:
        if imported_count > 0:
            from utils import log_activity_and_notify
            log_activity_and_notify(
                action="IMPORT",
                record_id=str(imported_count),
                user=user,
                request=request,
                entity="Facility",
                details=f"Bulk imported {imported_count} facilities",
            )
        db.session.commit()
    except IntegrityError:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": "One or more facilities have duplicate codes"}), 409
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to import facilities"}), 500

    try:
        from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
        clear_dashboard_cache()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return jsonify({"message": f"{imported_count} facilities imported"})

"""LDAR (Leak Detection and Repair) REST API endpoints.

Implements EPA Method 21 and Optical Gas Imaging (OGI) leak survey tracking
along with Component Inventory management (BUG-0030 / BUG-ARCH-002).
"""
import datetime
from flask import jsonify, request
from extensions import db
from models import ComponentInventory, FugitiveSurvey, Facility, User, Notification

def is_broken_status(status: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if status indicates a broken, damaged, or leaking component."""
    if not status:
        return False
    return str(status).strip().lower() in ("broken", "leaking", "damaged", "faulty", "needs repair")


def _serialize_component(comp):
    return {
        "id": comp.id,
        "facility_id": comp.facility_id,
        "facility_name": comp.facility.name if comp.facility else None,
        "emission_source_id": comp.emission_source_id,
        "equipment_type": comp.equipment_type,
        "component_type": comp.component_type,
        "service_type": comp.service_type,
        "quantity": comp.quantity,
        "operating_hours": comp.operating_hours,
        "methodology": comp.methodology,
        "factor_id": comp.factor_id,
        "factor_value": comp.factor_value,
        "factor_unit": comp.factor_unit,
        "api_reference": comp.api_reference,
        "status": comp.status,
        "description": comp.description,
        "created_by": comp.created_by,
        "created_at": comp.created_at.isoformat() if comp.created_at else None,
        "updated_at": comp.updated_at.isoformat() if comp.updated_at else None,
    }


def _serialize_survey(survey):
    return {
        "id": survey.id,
        "facility_id": survey.facility_id,
        "facility_name": survey.facility.name if survey.facility else None,
        "component_inventory_id": survey.component_inventory_id,
        "survey_method": survey.survey_method,
        "survey_date": survey.survey_date,
        "detection_threshold_ppm": survey.detection_threshold_ppm,
        "screening_value_ppm": survey.screening_value_ppm,
        "leak_status": survey.leak_status,
        "measured_emission_rate": survey.measured_emission_rate,
        "measurement_unit": survey.measurement_unit,
        "repair_date": survey.repair_date,
        "leaking_hours": survey.leaking_hours,
        "surveyor_name": survey.surveyor_name,
        "notes": survey.notes,
        "created_by": survey.created_by,
        "created_at": survey.created_at.isoformat() if survey.created_at else None,
    }

@ldar_bp.route("/components", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def list_components():
    """List component inventories filtered by facility and status."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user):
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: IT personnel cannot access operational LDAR data"}), 403

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    query = ComponentInventory.query

    if allowed_fids is not None:
        query = query.filter(ComponentInventory.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))

    fac_id = request.args.get("facility_id") or request.args.get("facilityId")
    if fac_id:
        try:
            fid = int(fac_id)
            if allowed_fids is not None and fid not in allowed_fids:
                return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized: Outside your assigned facilities"}), 403
            query = query.filter(ComponentInventory.facility_id == fid)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    status_arg = request.args.get("status")
    if status_arg:
        query = query.filter(ComponentInventory.status == status_arg)

    components = query.order_by(ComponentInventory.id.desc()).all()
    return jsonify({"components": [_serialize_component(c) for c in components], "count": len(components)})


@ldar_bp.route("/components", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def create_component():
    """Create a new component inventory item."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role == "auditor":
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Auditor and IT roles cannot modify LDAR components"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    facility_id = data.get("facility_id")
    if not facility_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Missing required field: facility_id"}), 400

    try:
        fid = int(facility_id)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid facility_id"}), 400

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    if allowed_fids is not None and fid not in allowed_fids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized: Outside your assigned facilities"}), 403

    facility = db.session.get(Facility, fid)
    if not facility:
        return jsonify({"error": "Facility not found"}), 404

    equipment_type = str(data.get("equipment_type") or "").strip()
    component_type = str(data.get("component_type") or "").strip()
    service_type = str(data.get("service_type") or "Gas").strip()

    if not equipment_type or not component_type:
        return jsonify({"error": "equipment_type and component_type are required"}), 400

    try:
        quantity = int(data.get("quantity", 1))
        if quantity < 0:
            return jsonify({"error": "quantity cannot be negative"}), 400
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        quantity = 1

    try:
        operating_hours = float(data.get("operating_hours", 8760.0))
        if operating_hours < 0 or operating_hours > 8760.0:
            return jsonify({"error": "operating_hours must be between 0 and 8760"}), 400
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        operating_hours = 8760.0

    comp = ComponentInventory(
        facility_id=fid,
        emission_source_id=data.get("emission_source_id"),
        equipment_type=equipment_type,
        component_type=component_type,
        service_type=service_type,
        quantity=quantity,
        operating_hours=operating_hours,
        methodology=str(data.get("methodology") or "Component Average"),
        factor_id=data.get("factor_id"),
        factor_value=data.get("factor_value"),
        factor_unit=data.get("factor_unit"),
        api_reference=data.get("api_reference"),
        status=data.get("status", "Active"),
        description=data.get("description"),
        created_by=user.id,
    )

    try:
        db.session.add(comp)
        db.session.flush()

        if is_broken_status(comp.status):
            Notification.create(
                title="LDAR Alert: Broken Component Added",
                message=f"A broken component ({comp.component_type} - {comp.equipment_type}) was recorded at {facility.name} (Status: {comp.status}).",
                type="warning",
                user_id=None,
                metadata={
                    "facility_id": comp.facility_id,
                    "facility_name": facility.name,
                    "component_id": comp.id,
                    "component_type": comp.component_type,
                    "equipment_type": comp.equipment_type,
                    "status": comp.status,
                    "created_by": user.fullName or user.email,
                },
            )

        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="CREATE",
            record_id=str(comp.id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="ComponentInventory",
            entity_id=str(comp.id),
            details=f"Created component inventory {comp.component_type} for facility {facility.name}",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to create component inventory: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({"message": "Component created successfully", "component": _serialize_component(comp)}), 201

@ldar_bp.route("/components/<int:comp_id>", methods=["PUT"])
@login_required
def update_component(comp_id):
    """Update an existing component inventory record."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role == "auditor":
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Auditor and IT roles cannot modify LDAR components"}), 403

    comp = db.session.get(ComponentInventory, comp_id)
    if not comp:
        return jsonify({"error": "Component not found"}), 404

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    if allowed_fids is not None and comp.facility_id not in allowed_fids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    old_status = comp.status
    for key in ("equipment_type", "component_type", "service_type", "methodology", "factor_id",
                "factor_value", "factor_unit", "api_reference", "status", "description"):
        if key in data:
            setattr(comp, key, data[key])

    if "quantity" in data:
        try:
            qty = int(data["quantity"])
            if qty < 0:
                return jsonify({"error": "quantity cannot be negative"}), 400
            comp.quantity = qty
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "quantity must be an integer"}), 400
    if "operating_hours" in data:
        try:
            hrs = float(data["operating_hours"])
            if hrs < 0 or hrs > 8760.0:
                return jsonify({"error": "operating_hours must be between 0 and 8760"}), 400
            comp.operating_hours = hrs
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "operating_hours must be a number"}), 400

    comp.updated_at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    if is_broken_status(comp.status) and not is_broken_status(old_status):
        facility_name = comp.facility.name if comp.facility else f"Facility #{comp.facility_id}"
        Notification.create(
            title="LDAR Alert: Component Marked Broken",
            message=f"Component #{comp.id} ({comp.component_type} - {comp.equipment_type}) was marked as '{comp.status}' at {facility_name}.",
            type="warning",
            user_id=None,
            metadata={
                "facility_id": comp.facility_id,
                "facility_name": facility_name,
                "component_id": comp.id,
                "component_type": comp.component_type,
                "equipment_type": comp.equipment_type,
                "status": comp.status,
                "updated_by": user.fullName or user.email,
            },
        )

    try:
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to update component: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({"message": "Component updated successfully", "component": _serialize_component(comp)})

@ldar_bp.route("/components/bulk-update", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def bulk_update_components():
    """Bulk update status, operating hours, or other attributes of components."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role == "auditor":
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Auditor and IT roles cannot modify LDAR components"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    ids = data.get("ids", [])
    if not isinstance(ids, list) or not ids:
        return jsonify({"error": "ids list is required and cannot be empty"}), 400

    try:
        int_ids = [int(i) for i in ids]
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid component IDs"}), 400

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    query = ComponentInventory.query.filter(ComponentInventory.id.in_(int_ids))
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        query = query.filter(ComponentInventory.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))

    components = query.all()
    if not components:
        return jsonify({"error": "No matching components found or unauthorized"}), 404

    new_status = data.get("status")
    new_service_type = data.get("service_type")
    new_equipment_type = data.get("equipment_type")
    new_operating_hours = data.get("operating_hours")

    if new_operating_hours is not None:
        try:
            new_operating_hours = float(new_operating_hours)
            if new_operating_hours < 0 or new_operating_hours > 8760.0:
                return jsonify({"error": "operating_hours must be between 0 and 8760"}), 400
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "operating_hours must be a valid number"}), 400

    broken_components_marked = []
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    for comp in components:
        old_status = comp.status
        if new_status is not None and str(new_status).strip():
            comp.status = str(new_status).strip()
            if is_broken_status(comp.status) and not is_broken_status(old_status):
                broken_components_marked.append(comp)
        if new_service_type is not None and str(new_service_type).strip():
            comp.service_type = str(new_service_type).strip()
        if new_equipment_type is not None and str(new_equipment_type).strip():
            comp.equipment_type = str(new_equipment_type).strip()
        if new_operating_hours is not None:
            comp.operating_hours = new_operating_hours
        comp.updated_at = now

    if broken_components_marked:
        Notification.create(
            title="LDAR Alert: Components Marked Broken",
            message=f"{len(broken_components_marked)} component(s) were marked as broken/leaking via bulk update.",
            type="warning",
            user_id=None,
            metadata={
                "component_ids": [c.id for c in broken_components_marked],
                "status": new_status,
                "updated_by": user.fullName or user.email,
            },
        )

    try:
        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="BULK_UPDATE",
            record_id=str(len(components)),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="ComponentInventory",
            entity_id="bulk",
            details=f"Bulk updated {len(components)} LDAR component(s)",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to bulk update components: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({
        "message": f"Successfully updated {len(components)} component(s)",
        "updated_count": len(components),
        "updated_ids": [c.id for c in components],
    }), 200


@ldar_bp.route("/components/bulk-delete", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def bulk_delete_components():
    """Bulk delete component inventory records."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Only Administrators can delete LDAR components"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    ids = data.get("ids", [])
    if not isinstance(ids, list) or not ids:
        return jsonify({"error": "ids list is required and cannot be empty"}), 400

    try:
        int_ids = [int(i) for i in ids]
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid component IDs"}), 400

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    query = ComponentInventory.query.filter(ComponentInventory.id.in_(int_ids))
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        query = query.filter(ComponentInventory.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))

    components = query.all()
    if not components:
        return jsonify({"error": "No matching components found or unauthorized"}), 404

    deleted_count = len(components)
    for comp in components:
        db.session.delete(comp)

    try:
        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="BULK_DELETE",
            record_id=str(deleted_count),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="ComponentInventory",
            entity_id="bulk",
            details=f"Bulk deleted {deleted_count} LDAR component(s)",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to bulk delete components: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({
        "message": f"Successfully deleted {deleted_count} component(s)",
        "deleted_count": deleted_count,
    }), 200

@ldar_bp.route("/surveys", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def create_survey():
    """Create a new fugitive leak survey record."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role == "auditor":
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Auditor and IT roles cannot modify LDAR surveys"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    facility_id = data.get("facility_id")
    if not facility_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Missing required field: facility_id"}), 400

    try:
        fid = int(facility_id)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid facility_id"}), 400

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    if allowed_fids is not None and fid not in allowed_fids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized: Outside your assigned facilities"}), 403

    facility = db.session.get(Facility, fid)
    if not facility:
        return jsonify({"error": "Facility not found"}), 404

    survey_method = str(data.get("survey_method") or "Method 21").strip()
    survey_date = str(data.get("survey_date") or datetime.date.today().isoformat()).strip()

    survey = FugitiveSurvey(
        facility_id=fid,
        component_inventory_id=data.get("component_inventory_id"),
        survey_method=survey_method,
        survey_date=survey_date,
        detection_threshold_ppm=data.get("detection_threshold_ppm"),
        screening_value_ppm=data.get("screening_value_ppm"),
        leak_status=data.get("leak_status", "Non-leaking"),
        measured_emission_rate=data.get("measured_emission_rate"),
        measurement_unit=data.get("measurement_unit", "kg/hr"),
        repair_date=data.get("repair_date"),
        leaking_hours=float(data["leaking_hours"]) if data.get("leaking_hours") is not None else 8760.0,
        surveyor_name=data.get("surveyor_name", user.fullName),
        notes=data.get("notes"),
        created_by=user.id,
    )

    try:
        db.session.add(survey)
        db.session.flush()

        if survey.leak_status == "Leaking":
            Notification.create(
                title="LDAR Alert: Leak Detected in Survey",
                message=f"A leak was detected during {survey.survey_method} survey at {facility.name} (Screening: {survey.screening_value_ppm or 0} ppm).",
                type="warning",
                user_id=None,
                metadata={
                    "facility_id": survey.facility_id,
                    "facility_name": facility.name,
                    "survey_id": survey.id,
                    "component_inventory_id": survey.component_inventory_id,
                    "screening_value_ppm": survey.screening_value_ppm,
                    "survey_method": survey.survey_method,
                    "surveyor_name": survey.surveyor_name,
                },
            )

        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="CREATE",
            record_id=str(survey.id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="FugitiveSurvey",
            entity_id=str(survey.id),
            details=f"Logged LDAR survey ({survey.survey_method}) for facility {facility.name}",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to log fugitive survey: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({"message": "Survey recorded successfully", "survey": _serialize_survey(survey)}), 201

@ldar_bp.route("/surveys/<int:survey_id>", methods=["PUT", "PATCH"])
@login_required
def update_survey(survey_id):
    """Update a fugitive survey record (e.g. record leak repairs, post-repair PPM)."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role in ["auditor", "viewer"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Read-only and IT roles cannot modify LDAR surveys"}), 403

    survey = db.session.get(FugitiveSurvey, survey_id)
    if not survey:
        return jsonify({"error": "Survey not found"}), 404

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    if allowed_fids is not None and survey.facility_id not in allowed_fids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    old_leak_status = survey.leak_status
    updatable_fields = [
        "survey_method", "survey_date", "detection_threshold_ppm",
        "screening_value_ppm", "leak_status", "measured_emission_rate",
        "measurement_unit", "repair_date", "leaking_hours",
        "surveyor_name", "notes"
    ]
    for f in updatable_fields:
        if f in data:
            val = data[f]
            if f == "leaking_hours" and val is not None:
                try:
                    val = float(val)
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    val = survey.leaking_hours
            setattr(survey, f, val)

    if survey.leak_status == "Leaking" and old_leak_status != "Leaking":
        fac_name = survey.facility.name if survey.facility else f"Facility #{survey.facility_id}"
        Notification.create(
            title="LDAR Alert: Survey Marked Leaking",
            message=f"Survey #{survey.id} was marked as Leaking at {fac_name}.",
            type="warning",
            user_id=None,
            metadata={
                "facility_id": survey.facility_id,
                "facility_name": fac_name,
                "survey_id": survey.id,
                "screening_value_ppm": survey.screening_value_ppm,
                "updated_by": user.fullName or user.email,
            },
        )

    try:
        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="UPDATE",
            record_id=str(survey.id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="FugitiveSurvey",
            entity_id=str(survey.id),
            details=f"Updated LDAR survey for facility {survey.facility.name if survey.facility else survey.facility_id}",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to update survey: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({"message": "Survey updated successfully", "survey": _serialize_survey(survey)}), 200

@ldar_bp.route("/surveys/bulk-update", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def bulk_update_surveys():
    """Bulk update leak status, repair date, or notes on fugitive surveys."""
    user = get_current_user()
    if is_it_role(user) or user.role in ["auditor", "viewer"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: Read-only and IT roles cannot modify LDAR surveys"}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    ids = data.get("ids", [])
    if not isinstance(ids, list) or not ids:
        return jsonify({"error": "ids list is required and cannot be empty"}), 400

    try:
        int_ids = [int(i) for i in ids]
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid survey IDs"}), 400

    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
    query = FugitiveSurvey.query.filter(FugitiveSurvey.id.in_(int_ids))
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        query = query.filter(FugitiveSurvey.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))

    surveys = query.all()
    if not surveys:
        return jsonify({"error": "No matching surveys found or unauthorized"}), 404

    new_leak_status = data.get("leak_status")
    repair_date = data.get("repair_date")
    notes = data.get("notes")
    survey_method = data.get("survey_method")
    post_repair_ppm = data.get("screening_value_ppm")

    leaks_marked = []
    for s in surveys:
        old_leak_status = s.leak_status
        if new_leak_status is not None and str(new_leak_status).strip():
            s.leak_status = str(new_leak_status).strip()
            if s.leak_status == "Leaking" and old_leak_status != "Leaking":
                leaks_marked.append(s)
        if repair_date is not None:
            s.repair_date = str(repair_date).strip() if repair_date else None
        if post_repair_ppm is not None:
            try:
                s.screening_value_ppm = float(post_repair_ppm)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                pass
        if notes:
            note_str = str(notes).strip()
            if note_str:
                s.notes = f"{s.notes} | {note_str}" if s.notes else note_str
        if survey_method is not None and str(survey_method).strip():
            s.survey_method = str(survey_method).strip()

    if leaks_marked:
        Notification.create(
            title="LDAR Alert: Surveys Marked Leaking",
            message=f"{len(leaks_marked)} survey(s) were updated to Leaking status.",
            type="warning",
            user_id=None,
            metadata={
                "survey_ids": [s.id for s in leaks_marked],
                "updated_by": user.fullName or user.email,
            },
        )

    try:
        db.session.commit()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="BULK_UPDATE",
            record_id=str(len(surveys)),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="FugitiveSurvey",
            entity_id="bulk",
            details=f"Bulk updated {len(surveys)} LDAR survey(s)",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return jsonify({"error": f"Failed to bulk update surveys: {e}"}), 500

    return jsonify({
        "message": f"Successfully updated {len(surveys)} survey(s)",
        "updated_count": len(surveys),
        "updated_ids": [s.id for s in surveys],
    }), 200

@managedata_bp.route("/sources", methods=["POST"])

@login_required
def add_source():
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["auditor", "it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Read-only auditor and IT roles cannot modify operational emission sources."}), 403
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    fid = data.get("facility_id")
    if not fid:
        return jsonify({"error": "Facility ID is required"}), 400
    try:
        fid = int(fid)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid facility ID"}), 400

    if (denied := facility_access_error(user, fid)):
        return denied

    source = EmissionSource(
        facility_id=fid,
        name=data.get("name"),
        type=data.get("type"),
        equipment_id=data.get("equipment_id"),
        fuel_type=data.get("fuel_type"),
        design_capacity=data.get("design_capacity"),
        installation_date=data.get("installation_date"),
        status=data.get("status", "Active"),
        description=data.get("description"),
        activity=data.get("activity"),
        division=data.get("division"),
        field=data.get("field"),
        region=data.get("region"),
    )
    try:
        db.session.add(source)
        db.session.flush()
        log_activity_and_notify(
            "CREATE",
            source.id,
            f"Added emission source {source.name}",
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="EmissionSource",
        )
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return internal_error(e, "Failed to add source")

    return jsonify({"message": "Source added", "id": source.id}), 201

@managedata_bp.route("/mitigation", methods=["GET"])
@managedata_bp.route("/mitigation/", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_mitigations():
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "IT administrators are not authorized to view operational mitigation data."}), 403
    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)

    # Fetch Records (Legacy/Generic) â€” not facility-linked, visible to all
    records = MitigationRecord.query.all()

    # Fetch Projects (Facility-linked) â€” apply access filter
    proj_query = db.session.query(MitigationProject, Facility).outerjoin(
        Facility, MitigationProject.facility_id == Facility.id
    )
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        proj_query = proj_query.filter(
            or_(
                MitigationProject.facility_id.is_(None),
                MitigationProject.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids),
            )
        )
    projects = proj_query.all()

    results = []

    # Process Records
    for m in records:
        results.append(
            {
                "id": f"rec_{m.id}",
                "type": "record",
                "year": m.year,
                "name": f"{m.type}",  # Generic name
                "mitigation_type": m.type,
                "subtype": m.subtype,
                "quantity_tco2e": m.quantity_tco2e,
                "notes": m.notes,
                "reference_id": m.reference_id,
                "activity": "-",
                "division": "-",
                "region": "-",
                "status": "Active",
            }
        )

    # Process Projects
    for p, f in projects:
        results.append(
            {
                "id": f"proj_{p.id}",
                "type": "project",
                "facility_id": p.facility_id,
                "facility_name": f.name if f else "-",
                "year": p.year,
                "name": p.name,
                "mitigation_type": p.project_type,
                "subtype": "-",
                "quantity_tco2e": p.quantity_tco2e,
                "notes": p.description,
                "reference_id": "-",
                "activity": f.activity if f else "-",
                "division": f.division if f else "-",
                "region": (f.location or f.region or f.name) if f else "-",
                "status": p.status,
            }
        )

    return jsonify(results)

            quantity_tco2e=data.get("quantity_tco2e", 0),
            notes=data.get("notes"),
            reference_id=data.get("reference_id"),
        )
        db.session.add(mitigation)
        try:
            db.session.flush()
            from utils import log_activity_and_notify
            log_activity_and_notify(
                action="CREATE",
                record_id=f"rec_{mitigation.id}",
                user=user,
                request=request,
                entity="MitigationRecord",
                entity_id=str(mitigation.id),
                details=f"Created mitigation record ({mitigation.type}, {mitigation.quantity_tco2e} tCO2e)",
            )
            db.session.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            db.session.rollback()
            return internal_error(e, "Failed to add mitigation record")

        from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
        clear_dashboard_cache()

@managedata_bp.route("/mitigation/<string:mitigation_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@login_required
def delete_mitigation(mitigation_id):
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["auditor", "it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "Read-only auditor and IT roles cannot modify mitigation data."}), 403
    # Determine type from ID prefix
    if mitigation_id.startswith("proj_"):
        try:
            pid = int(mitigation_id.split("_")[1])
        except (IndexError, ValueError):
            return jsonify({"error": "Invalid project ID format"}), 400
        item = db.session.get(MitigationProject, pid)
    elif mitigation_id.startswith("rec_"):
        try:
            rid = int(mitigation_id.split("_")[1])
        except (IndexError, ValueError):
            return jsonify({"error": "Invalid record ID format"}), 400
        item = db.session.get(MitigationRecord, rid)
    else:
        # Fallback for old IDs (assume record)
        try:
            item = db.session.get(MitigationRecord, int(mitigation_id))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "Invalid ID format"}), 400

    if not item:
        return jsonify({"error": "Record not found"}), 404

    if isinstance(item, MitigationProject) and item.facility_id:
        allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)
        if allowed_fids is not None and item.facility_id not in allowed_fids:
            return jsonify({"error": "Access to this facility is denied"}), 403
    elif isinstance(item, MitigationRecord):
        if not user or user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"]:
            return jsonify({"error": "Admin or Superuser privileges required to delete corporate mitigation records"}), 403

    try:
        db.session.delete(item)
        from utils import log_activity_and_notify
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="DELETE",
            record_id=str(mitigation_id),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity=item.__class__.__name__,
            entity_id=str(item.id),
            facility_id=getattr(item, "facility_id", None),
            details=f"Deleted {item.__class__.__name__} #{item.id}",
        )
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return internal_error(e, "Failed to delete mitigation item")

    from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
    clear_dashboard_cache()
    return jsonify({"message": "Mitigation record deleted"})

@managedata_bp.route("/reporting-metadata", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def save_reporting_metadata():
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "IT administrators are not authorized to modify reporting metadata."}), 403
    # one row per year for the whole organisation: organisation-wide admins only
    if not user or user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"] or get_allowed_facility_ids(user) is not None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Organisation-wide administrator privileges required to modify reporting metadata."}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    if not data.get("year"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Year required"}), 400
    year = parse_year(data.get("year"))  # F13: a non-numeric year raised a 500

    metadata = ReportingMetadata.query.filter_by(year=year).first()
    if metadata:
        metadata.has_reduction_target = data.get(
            "has_reduction_target", metadata.has_reduction_target
        )
        metadata.target_description = data.get(
            "target_description", metadata.target_description
        )
        metadata.is_tcfd_aligned = data.get("is_tcfd_aligned", metadata.is_tcfd_aligned)
        metadata.assurance_level = data.get("assurance_level", metadata.assurance_level)
        metadata.assurance_provider = data.get(
            "assurance_provider", metadata.assurance_provider
        )
        metadata.notes = data.get("notes", metadata.notes)
    else:
        metadata = ReportingMetadata(
            year=int(year),
            has_reduction_target=data.get("has_reduction_target", 0),
            target_description=data.get("target_description", ""),
            is_tcfd_aligned=data.get("is_tcfd_aligned", 0),
            assurance_level=data.get("assurance_level", "None"),
            assurance_provider=data.get("assurance_provider", ""),
            notes=data.get("notes", ""),
        )
        db.session.add(metadata)

    try:
        from utils import log_activity_and_notify
        log_activity_and_notify(
            action="UPDATE",
            record_id=str(year),
            user=user,
            request=request,
            entity="ReportingMetadata",
            entity_id=str(year),
            details=f"Reporting metadata for {year} was updated",
        )
        Notification.create(
            title="Reporting Metadata Updated",
            message=f"Reporting metadata for {year} was updated.",
            type="audit",
            user_id=None,
        )
        db.session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        return internal_error(e, "Failed to save reporting metadata")

    return jsonify({"message": "Reporting metadata saved"})

# --- Global Available Filters ---
@managedata_bp.route("/filters/available", methods=["GET"])
@login_required
def get_available_filters():
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "IT administrators are not authorized to view operational filters."}), 403
    allowed_fids = get_allowed_facility_ids(user)

    year_queries = [
        db.session.query(distinct(Emission.year)),
        db.session.query(distinct(ProductionData.year)),
        db.session.query(distinct(MitigationRecord.year)),
        db.session.query(distinct(Scope2Emission.year)),
        db.session.query(distinct(Scope3Emission.year)),
    ]

    available_years = set()
    for query in year_queries:
        try:
            results = query.all()
            for r in results:
                if r[0]:
                    available_years.add(int(r[0]))
        except Exception:
            continue

    em_query = db.session.query(distinct(Emission.facility_id))
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        em_query = em_query.filter(Emission.facility_id.in_(allowed_fids))
    referenced_facility_ids = em_query.all()
    facility_ids = [r[0] for r in referenced_facility_ids if r[0]]

    # Get facility details
    fac_query = Facility.query
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        fac_query = fac_query.filter(Facility.id.in_(allowed_fids))
    facilities = (
        fac_query.filter(Facility.id.in_(facility_ids)).all()
        if facility_ids
        else fac_query.all()
    )

    segment_query = db.session.query(distinct(Facility.segment))
    if allowed_fids is not None:
        segment_query = segment_query.filter(Facility.id.in_(allowed_fids))
    
    # Strictly enforce only valid supply chain keywords: Upstream, Midstream, Downstream
    VALID_SEGMENTS = {"upstream", "midstream", "downstream"}
    raw_segments = [r[0] for r in segment_query.all() if r[0]]
    segments = sorted(list({s.strip().title() for s in raw_segments if s.strip().lower() in VALID_SEGMENTS}))
    if not segments:
        segments = ["Downstream", "Midstream", "Upstream"]

    return jsonify(
        {
            "years": sorted(list(available_years), reverse=True),
            "segments": segments,
            "regions": [
                {
                    "id": f.id,
                    "name": f.name,
                    "region": f.region or f.location or f.name,
                    "location": f.location or f.region,
                    "activity": f.activity,
                    "division": f.division,
                    "field": f.field,
                    "segment": f.segment,
                }
                for f in facilities
            ],
        }
    )

@managedata_bp.route("/goals", methods=["POST"])

def add_or_update_goal():
    user = get_current_user()
    if user and user.role in ["it_admin", "it_manager", "it"]:
        return jsonify({"error": "IT administrators are not authorized to modify corporate emission targets."}), 403
    if not user or user.role not in ["admin", "superuser"] or get_allowed_facility_ids(user) is not None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Organisation-wide administrator privileges required to modify corporate emission targets."}), 403
    from input_validation import parse_number

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    # BUG-039: finite, positive target and a plausible year (targets may lie in the future)
    year = int(parse_number(data.get("year"), "year", min_value=1990, max_value=2100))
    if year != parse_number(data.get("year"), "year"):
        return jsonify({"error": "'year' must be a whole year", "field": "year"}), 400
    target = parse_number(data.get("target_amount"), "target_amount")
    if target <= 0:
        return jsonify({"error": "'target_amount' must be greater than 0", "field": "target_amount"}), 400

    existing = Goal.query.filter_by(year=year).first()
    if existing:
        existing.target_amount = target
    else:
        db.session.add(Goal(year=year, target_amount=target))
    log_activity_and_notify(action="UPDATE", record_id=f"goal-{year}", user=user, request=request,
                            entity="Goal", details=f"Emission goal for {year} set to {target} tCO2e")
    db.session.commit()
    from routes.dashboard import clear_dashboard_cache
    clear_dashboard_cache()
    return jsonify({"message": "Emission goal saved successfully", "year": year, "target_amount": target}), 200
